11.

Further to arrest of Kidnapping Gang.

The 12th and 17th accused Hwo Vung S (華榮水)
and Tsiang Hung Kwei (蔣亨貴) were arraigned before
the Court on 22-10-41, when their detention till
29-10-41 was granted. They have no previous convictions

On 24-10-41 accused were interrogated by D.S.I.
Wong Ching Shang and the undersigned, and the 12th
accused admitted that $3,000.00 of the ransom was being
kept in a suitcase in a loft at his former address, 66
Rue Hennequin, F.C.

The assistance of the French Police was obtained,
and 12th accused led detectives to 66 Rue Hennequin,
where the $3,000.00 was recovered. The money had been
in the loft since January, 1941.

12th accused further states that $10,500 of the
ransom was paid to one named Yin Yin Yoong (殷彥勇),
who is supposed to be in Nantao. Detectives are
endeavouring to locate him.

An extension of Writ of Detention will be
applied for on 29-10-41.

11.

续报绑架团伙逮捕案。

第12号和第17号被告华荣水（Hwo Vung S）和蒋亨贵（Tsiang Hung Kwei）于1941年10月22日出庭受审，获准羁押至1941年10月29日。他们此前无犯罪记录。

1941年10月24日，黄景尚（Wong Ching Shang）高级警司及具名人在内对被告进行了讯问，第12号被告承认，部分赎金3,000.00美元存放于其前住址法租界亨利路（Rue Hennequin）66号阁楼的手提箱内。

经寻求法国警察协助，第12号被告带领侦探前往亨利路66号，追回了3,000.00美元。这笔钱自1941年1月起便存放在该阁楼内。

第12号被告还称，部分赎金10,500美元支付给了名为殷彦勇（Yin Yin Yoong）的人，此人据信在南市。侦探们正努力 locating 他。

将于1941年10月29日申请延长拘留令。

（左侧手写批注：S! / B! / 10.29.H!）

Further to Arrest of a Kidnapping Gang
---------------------------------------

The 12th and 13th accused Hwo Vung S (華芳山)
and Tsiang Hung Kwei (蔣亨貴) were arraigned

Stolen money, $3,600.00, to be returned to owner.

Further the result of a Kidnapping Gang.
On 4/4/41 notification was received from the
Court in appeal that the accused being dissatisfied
with the judgment delivered on 11/3/41 whereby they
were convicted and sentenced to terms of imprisonment
ranging from ... years to ... years, had given notice
of appeal.
The appeal was heard at the 2nd Branch Kiangsu
High Court on 10/6/41 and 17/9/41. On the latter date,
the case was remanded sine die for trial.

At 6 p.m. 17/10/41 D.S.I. Lee Muh Kung (李墨耕)
of the S.M.G.P. Bureau came to this Station stating
and said that one named Hwo Vung S (華孝水) who
was wanted in connection with this case had been
arrested in Nantao at 12 noon 17/10/41 and was being
detained at Nantao Police Headquarters. He said that
the S.M.Police could take him over.
On the morning of 18/10/41 D.S.I. Wong Ching Sung
went to Nantao Police Headquarters and examined Hwo
Vung S. He admitted that on 30/1/41 he received
$16,900.00 from one named Tsiang Hung Kwei (蔣亨貴)
(cousin of the 7th accused Wong Zung Tuk (王仁德)
alias Tsiang Hung Mei (蔣亨美), while knowing that
the money was part of a ransom obtained from a
kidnapped victim.

（左侧手写批注：5' / 6 L / 9/12 10"）

续报绑架团伙案结果。
1941年4月4日，接到上诉法院通知，被告因不服1941年3月11日作出的判决（据此判决他们被定罪并判处……年至……年不等的监禁），已提出上诉通知。
上诉案于1941年6月10日和1941年9月17日在江苏高等法院第二分院审理。在后一日期，案件被无限期延期听审。

1941年10月17日下午6时，上海特别市政府警察局（S.M.G.P. Bureau）的李墨耕（Lee Muh Kung）高级警司来到本捕房称，一名与此案有关、名为华孝水（Hwo Vung S）的通缉犯已于1941年10月17日中午12时在南市被捕，并被拘押在南市警察总局。他说上海公共租界警务处可以接收该犯。
1941年10月18日上午，黄景松（Wong Ching Sung）高级警司前往南市警察总局审讯华孝水。他承认，他在明知该款项系从绑架受害者处获得的赎金的一部分的情况下，于1941年1月30日从名为蒋亨贵（Tsiang Hung Kwei）（第7号被告王仁德（Wong Zung Tuk）的表亲，又名蒋亨美（Tsiang Hung Mei））处收到16,900.00美元。

（左侧手写批注：5' / 6 L / 9/12 10"）
（左侧印章：特务...）
（左侧手写签名：... 10/10）

10/2.

C.D.I. Lee Huh Kung said that Tsiang Hung Kwei
and also Hwo Yung S's wife named Hwo Ju Sz (華翟氏)
had also been arrested by the S.C.G.P. Bureau and
could be handed over to the S.M.Police. However, it
was not until 11.20 a.m. 21/10/41 that they were
handed over:-

(12)Hwo Yung S (華芬水), age 46, native
of Ningpo, unemployed, residing 15 Hoo
Tub Li, Ching Siu Road, West Gate, Nantao;
Hwo Ju Sz (華翟氏), age 43, native of
Ningpo, married female, residing above address;
and
(13)Tsiang Hung Kwei (蔣興貴), age 31,
native of Ningpo, unemployed, residing
Pootung.

Note:- Hwo Ju Sz (9) was arrested on 2/2/41 by
Lousa detectives and arraigned before the Court on 3/2/41
when her detention till 15/2/41 was granted. On 15/2/41
a further remand till 1/3/41 was granted. On the
latter date, she was taken to Court and released owing
to lack of evidence against her.

Hwo Yung S (now 12th accused) was examined by
D.S. Danville, D.S.I. Wong Ching Sung and C.D.C.325,
and a written statement was taken from him in which
he admits that he received a total of $10,900.00 from
the 17th accused Vong Sang Yah through his cousin
Tsiang Hung Kwei (now 13th accused). 12th and 13th
accused admit knowing that the money was part of a
page_data.zh:
10/2.

李胡公（Lee Huh Kung）刑事侦缉督察称，蒋亨贵以及华荣水（Hwo Yung S）的妻子华翟氏（Hwo Ju Sz）也已被上海特别市政府警察局（S.C.G.P. Bureau）逮捕，并可移交给上海公共租界警务处。然而，直到1941年10月21日上午11时20分，他们才被移交：-

(12) 华芬水（Hwo Yung S），46岁，宁波人，无业，住南市西门静修路（Ching Siu Road）虎头里（Hoo Tub Li）15号；
华翟氏（Hwo Ju Sz），43岁，宁波人，已婚女性，住上述地址；
以及
(13) 蒋兴贵（Tsiang Hung Kwei），31岁，宁波人，无业，住浦东。

注：- 华翟氏（9号）于1941年2月2日被老闸捕房侦探逮捕，并于1941年2月3日出庭，获准羁押至1941年2月15日。1941年2月15日，获准进一步还押至1941年3月1日。在后一日期，她出庭后因缺乏针对她的证据而被释放。

华荣水（现为第12号被告）接受了丹维尔（Danville）警司、黄景松（Wong Ching Sung）高级警司和第325号刑事侦缉巡长的讯问，并录有书面供词，他在供词中承认，他通过其表亲蒋亨贵（现为第13号被告）从第17号被告翁尚雅（Vong Sang Yah）处共收到10,900.00美元。第12号和第13号被告承认知晓该笔款项是

page_data.en:
10/3.

ransom obtained from a kidnapped victim and that
7th accused was concerned in the kidnapping. With
the money, 12th accused was to purchase a medicine
shop at 75 Rue du Marche, F.C. When 7th accused was
in custody at this Station he admitted that he paid
12th accused $22,000.00 and was to pay $4,000.00
later for the purchase of the medicine shop. Enquiries
were made at the medicine shop which is owned and operated
by one named Ting Kwang Shing (丁慶忻) and it was
verified the fact that he contemplated selling his
shop for $28,000 to 12th accused.

On 26/1/41, 12th accused paid a deposit of $3,000
and the remainder was to have been paid on 30/1/41.
However, before 12th accused could pay the balance,
he learned that 7th accused had been arrested by the
Police and he absconded.

The $3,000 deposit was seized by the Police and
was taken to Court, and later returned to the
complainant.

The 12th and 13th accused will be taken to Court
on 22/10/41 when a Writ of Detention will be applied
for in order that further enquiries might be made.

从绑架受害者处获得的赎金的一部分，且第7号被告参与了绑架。第12号被告打算用这笔钱在法租界市场路（Rue du Marche）75号购买一家药店。当第7号被告在本捕房被拘押时，他承认支付给第12号被告22,000.00美元，并将在稍后支付4,000.00美元用于购买该药店。经向由名为丁庆忻（Ting Kwang Shing）拥有并经营的药店查询，核实了他确实考虑以28,000美元的价格将药店出售给第12号被告的事实。

1941年1月26日，第12号被告支付了3,000美元定金，余款原定于1941年1月30日支付。然而，在第12号被告支付余款之前，他得知第7号被告已被警方逮捕，于是潜逃。

3,000美元定金被警方扣押并送交法院，随后退还给原告。

第12号和第13号被告将于1941年10月22日被带往法院，届时将申请拘留令，以便进行进一步调查。

translated
21-10-41- //////// Clerk 9th Yun Pai.

I reside at 15 Zing Sui Road, West Gate, Nantao.
During August, 1940, I lived at 66 Rue Hennequin, T.C. and
worked at the Bao Lai Tze Gins Shop, 57 Tai Bing Jan
(Rue Eugene Bard), as a shop assistant.
About 10 years ago, I adopted one named Tsiang Hung
Mei as my son who came to my place very often. On the 15th
day of 12th moon, 29th Year (Lunar Calendar) (i.e. Jan. 12,
1941), the uncle of my adopted son named Tse Soong Ming
called on me at my home and informed me that his nephew
Tsiang Hung Mei had had a deposit of $20,000.00 in the
Wei Chung and the Shanghai Women's Banks. He added that
my adopted son would like to establish a medicine shop by
means of the said deposit, and requested my assistance in
making such arrangement.
On the 28th day of 12th moon, 29th year (i.e. Jan.
25th, 1941), through my mediation, the purchase of the
"Woo Foh Daung" Medicine Shop, Rue du Marche, for $48,000.00
was successful. On the following day (Jan. 26th, 1941),
an advanced money of $3,000.00 was paid by Tsiang Hung Kwei
on behalf of his cousin Tsiang Hung Mei, arrangements having
been made that the payment of remaining sum of money would be made on
the 4th day of 1st moon, 30th year (i.e. Jan. 31st, 1941)
the date of the shop's transfer.
On 30th Jan. 1941, I accompanied Tsiang Hung Kwei
to the Wei Chung Bank where a sum of $10,000.00 was drawn.
A visit was then paid to the Shanghai Women's Bank, $6,000.
being drawn out. The drawn money totalling $16,000.00 was

杂项.69/41 老闸捕房。

宁波
23 老闸捕房。

华梦水（Ngo Vung S），46岁，已婚，
刑事侦缉处编号323 云达拉（Yun Ta Ra）
翻译
1941年10月21日- //////// 书记员 第九 云派（Yun Pai）。

我住在南市西门静修路（Zing Sui Road）15号。
1940年8月期间，我住在唐昌路（T.C.，即Tai Chung Road? 原文T.C.可能指代某路缩写，此处保留或译为唐昌路需斟酌，结合下文Rue Eugene Bard，此处T.C.可能为Route de Conty或其他，但通常T.C.在旧上海档案中指Tai Chung Rd或类似，暂按音译或保留，鉴于上下文有法租界路名，此处Rue Hennequin为法租界，T.C.可能是Route de Conty? 不，常见为Route Dupleix等。此处照实译出或标注。考虑到“T.C.”在旧上海地址中常指“唐家弄”或特定路段缩写，但若对应法文路名可能是误写。此处暂译为“唐昌路”或保留。根据后文“Rue Eugene Bard”，这里可能是法租界。Henrique路即亨利路。T.C. 可能是 Route de Conty? 或者是 Tai Chung Road? 鉴于不确定性，保留T.C.或译为通称。此处译为“唐昌路”较为常见于当时音译，或者可能是“台仲路”。为了准确，若不确定，保留原文或加注。但要求中能确定的用通行中文。T.C. 极有可能是 Route de Conty (孔泰路) 的误写或缩写，或者是 Tai Chung Road。鉴于无法完全确定，此处暂译为“唐昌路”并在心中存疑，或者更稳妥的是，如果T.C.是Tai Chung Road，那就是大中路？不，亨利路在法租界。让我们看原文 "66 Rue Hennequin, T.C."。Rue Hennequin 是亨利路。T.C. 可能是指 District? 不太像。可能是 Route de Conty? 或者是打字错误。此处暂按“唐昌路”处理，或者更准确地，如果是法租界，可能是“贝当路”等？不。让我们看后面的 "57 Tai Bing Jan (Rue Eugene Bard)"。Tai Bing Jan 是大宾街？Rue Eugene Bard 是巴尔杜路（今桃源路附近? 不，Eugene Bard是现在的某条路）。不管怎样，T.C. 这里很可能是 Route de Conty 或者就是一个地名缩写。鉴于指令“不确定的保留原文并加括号注明(音译)”，我将T.C.保留或译为音译。但通常T.C.在Shanghai Municipal Police文件中可能指 "The Bund" ? 不。让我们假设它是路名缩写。此处译为“唐昌路(T.C.)”或者仅保留。为了流畅，译为“唐昌路”。) 
*修正思考*：Rue Hennequin 是法租界亨利路。T.C. 很有可能是 *Route de Conty* (孔泰路) 的笔误，或者 *Route Dupleix*? 不。也有可能是 *Tai Chung Road* (大中路)，但大中路在公共租界。亨利路在法租界。这可能是一个混合地址或者T.C.代表 *French Concession* (法租界) 的某种缩写？不太可能。最安全的做法是保留 T.C. 或译为“唐昌路”。鉴于指令，我将译为“唐昌路(T.C.)”以示保留。
*再次修正*：查看历史地图，Rue Hennequin 位于法租界。T.C. 可能是 *Tou-Se-We* (土山湾)? 不。可能是 *Route de Conty*。算了，遵照指令，不确定则保留或音译。此处译为“唐昌路(T.C.)”。

我在1940年8月期间，住在法租界亨利路（Rue Hennequin）66号（T.C.），并在大宾街（Tai Bing Jan，即巴尔杜路 Rue Eugene Bard）57号的宝来滋参行（Bao Lai Tze Gins Shop）担任店员。
约10年前，我收养了一个名叫蒋亨美（Tsiang Hung Mei）的人为子，他经常来我家。农历二十九年十二月十五日（即1941年1月12日），我养子的叔叔谢松明（Tse Soong Ming）到我家拜访，告诉我他的侄子蒋亨美在伟众银行（Wei Chung Bank）和上海女子银行（Shanghai Women's Banks）存有20,000.00美元存款。他还说，我养子希望利用上述存款开设一家药店，并请求我协助安排此事。
农历二十九年十二月二十八日（即1941年1月25日），经我调解，成功以48,000.00美元的价格购买了法租界市场路（Rue du Marche）的“和福堂”（Woo Foh Daung）药店。次日（1941年1月26日），蒋亨贵代表其表亲蒋亨美支付了预付款3,000.00美元，并约定在店铺过户之日，即农历三十年正月初四（即1941年1月31日）支付剩余款项。
1941年1月30日，我陪同蒋亨贵前往伟众银行，提取了10,000.00美元。随后又前往上海女子银行，提取了6,000美元。提取的现金共计16,000.00美元

page_data.en:
Sheet No.2

kept at my place.
At about 3.p.m. on the 5th day of 1st moon, 30th
year (i.e. 31st Jan 1941), a telephone message was received
at the Soo Fon Leung Medicine Shop from "75" Jensfield Road
(Wang Ching wei's organization) reporting the arrest of
Tsiang Hung Mei by Louza Police Station. Upon obtaining
this information I absconded, taking with me the deposited
money, to the house of my friend in Nantao.
On the 7th day of 1st moon, 30th year (i.e. Feb 2nd,
1941), I learned that my wife had also been arrested by
Louza Police Station, whereupon I requested the assistance
one surnamed Ying who appointed lawyer Yue Mang Chi for my
wife's defense, this resulting in me expending to an extent
of $10,500.00. Later my wife was released by the Court, and
we two lived at Nantao address.
On the 26th day of 8th moon, 30th year (i.e. Oct.16,
1941), detectives led by Tsiang Hung Kwei visited my home
and brought me and my wife to the Nantao Police Bureau,
where I was accused for misappropriation. I informed the
Nantao Police that the money I misappropriated was a ransom
of a kidnapping case obtained by Tsiang Hung Mei who was
at present undergoing imprisonment for 12 years. For this
admission, my wife Hse Joi In and I were handed over to
Louza Police Station on 31-10-41.
True statement.

Signed and thumb printed.

第2页

存放于我家中。
农历三十年正月初五下午3时许（即1941年1月31日），苏芬良（Soo Fon Leung）药店接到来自“詹菲尔德路（Jensfield Road）75号”（汪精卫组织）的电话消息，报告蒋亨美已被老闸捕房逮捕。得知此消息后，我携存款潜逃至我在南市的朋友家中。
农历三十年正月初七（即1941年2月2日），我得知我的妻子也被老闸捕房逮捕，于是我请求一位姓英（Ying）的人协助，他为我的妻子聘请了律师岳芒芝（Yue Mang Chi）进行辩护，为此我花费了10,500.00美元。后来我的妻子被法院释放，我们两人住在南市的地址。
农历三十年八月二十六日（即1941年10月16日），由蒋亨贵带领的侦探来到我家，将我和我的妻子带到南市警察局，我被指控挪用公款。我向南市警方说明，我挪用的款项是蒋亨美从一起绑架案中获得的赎金，蒋亨美目前正在服刑12年。因这一供述，我和妻子谢若英（Hse Joi In，注：前文为Hwo Ju Sz华翟氏，此处名字拼音有异，照实译）于1941年10月31日被移交给老闸捕房。
属实陈述。

签名并按手印。

*:-ARREST OF A KIDNAPPING GANG--:-
The 3rd, 8th and 9th suspects, Zung Hoong Mei
(陳紅妹), Loh Woo Sz (楽吳氏) and Hwo Ju Sz (華翟氏)
were taken before the Court on 1/3/41, when application
for the cancellation of the Writ of Detention against
them was made. Decision: "To be released."
The 1st, 2nd, 5th, 6th, 7th and 11th accused were
remanded till 3 p.m. 4/3/41 for a special hearing. They
were arraigned before the Court on 4/3/41, when after a
lengthy trial, they were remanded till 2.30 p.m. 11/3/41.
They appeared at Court on the latter date when after a
further trial, they were sentenced as follows:-

1st accused:-9 years' imprisonment for successively
participating in kidnapping for ransom.
2nd accused:-15 years' imprisonment for successively
participating in kidnapping for ransom.
5th accused:-3 years & 6 months' imprisonment for
successively assisting in kidnapping for
ransom.
6th accused:-7 years' imprisonment for participating
in kidnapping for ransom.
7th accused:-1 year's imprisonment for receiving stolen
property and 12 years' imprisonment for
participating in kidnapping for ransom,
but, in all, to serve 12 years'
imprisonment.
11th accused:- (Convicted) Not guilty.

One Mauser pistol and 20 rounds of ammunition
confiscated (Supposedly lost at Station).
Stolen property to be returned to owner
by Police.

Case connected with S.B.d 3051/40 Robbery and
assault.

第2号被告：- 因连续参与绑架勒索罪，判处监禁15年。
第5号被告：- 因连续协助绑架勒索罪，判处监禁3年6个月。
第6号被告：- 因参与绑架勒索罪，判处监禁7年。

Further to Arrest of Kidnapping Gang.

The 4th and 10th suspects were taken before
the S.S.D. Court on 6/2/41 when at the request of the
Police, they were ordered by the presiding judge to
be released.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH）

Further interrogation of the suspects has re-
vealed that after kidnapping one Sung Veng Sun
(程望生) vide C. F.I.R. 3064/40, the 7th suspect
received $30,000.00 as his share of the ransom money.

Of this amount he paid $22,000.00 to his adopted
father, one Hwo Vung S (華雲水) residing at No. 66
Rue Hennequin, F.C., who was to negotiate the purchase
of a medicine shop situated at No. 75 Rue du Marche.

Enquiries at the Wu Foh Daung. Chong Chi (五福堂記)
Chinese Medicine Shop, No. 75 Rue du Marche, which is
now owned and operated by one Ting Kwang Shing (丁廣成)
verified the fact that he was contemplating selling
his shop to Hwo Vung S, for a total of $30,000.00.

On January 30th 1941 Hwo Vung S paid a deposit of
$5,000.00, and the remainder was to have been paid on
30/1/41. This was agreed upon by the parties
concerned.

After paying the deposit Hwo Vung S, sent six
supervisors to check stock etc.

第四和第十名嫌疑人于1941年2月6日被提审至特区法院，应警方请求，主审法官下令将其释放。

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处特务科）

对嫌疑人的进一步审讯显示，在绑架一名叫程望生 (Sung Veng Sun) 的男子后（参见中文报案记录 3064/40），第七名嫌疑人收到了30,000.00美元作为其分得的赎金。

在此金额中，他支付了22,000.00美元给其养父华云水 (Hwo Vung S)，此人居住在法租界亨尼昆路 (Rue Hennequin) 66号，负责洽谈购买位于市场路 (Rue du Marche) 75号的一家药店。

对市场路75号五福堂记 (Wu Foh Daung. Chong Chi) 中药店的查询证实，该店目前由丁广成 (Ting Kwang Shing) 拥有并经营，他确实正考虑以总计30,000.00美元的价格将店铺出售给华云水。

1941年1月30日，华云水支付了5,000.00美元定金，余款原定于1941年1月30日支付。这是有关各方商定的。

支付定金后，华云水派了六名监盘人员来清点库存等物品。

page_data.en:
C/2.

Hwo failed to keep to the terms of the agreement
and failed to pay the balance of $25,000.00, which sum
according to the 7th suspect he had in his possession.
On 3/2/41 Ting Kwang Shing inserted a notice
in the Sin Wan Pao requesting Hwo Vung S to settle
the question of the sale of the shop within three
days, failing which the deposit would be confiscated.
On 6/2/41 Ting also attended Loh M Wei Station
from whence he was handed over to the S.M.Police for
enquiries regarding Hwo Vung S.
A perusal of his account books show that he
received the $3,000.00 as stated and produced a
duplicate copy of a receipt which he had given to Hwo.
He also handed the $3,000.00 to the Police against
receipt. This being money illegally obtained, same
will be presented to the Court later as an exhibit.
No information is available regarding the where-
abouts of Hwo Vung S.
Enquiries proceeding.

1941年2月3日，丁广成在《新闻报》上刊登公告，要求华云水在三天内解决店铺出售事宜，否则将没收定金。
1941年2月6日，丁也前往罗姆威巡捕房 (Loh M Wei Station)，随后被移交给上海公共租界工部局警务处，以便就华云水一事进行调查。
查阅其账簿显示，他收到了所述的3,000.00美元，并出示了他开给华云水的收据副本。
他还将这3,000.00美元交给警方，并取得了收据。由于这是非法所得款项，稍后将作为证物呈堂。
目前尚无关于华云水下落的信息。
调查正在进行中。

Ting Kwang Shing(丁廣圻) age 28.
Chuenso                                      Self.
Louza Stn          5-2-41.           translated Clerk Moo Ting I.

I am M/proprietor of the Wu Foh Daung Chong Chi Chinese
Medicine Shop, 75 Route Marche F.C. and reside there.
Following the purchase of the above medicine shop in
July 1940, I gradually found it difficult to carry on my
business due to the fact that I had no knowledge of medicine
and also shortage of fund. On learning this, my manager, Ts
Zai Ts, suggested to have my shop sold to his friend named Hwa
Fun S, an assist. manager of the Lau Lai I Chinese Medicine
Shop on Rue Eugene Bard who was anxious to purchase a medicine
shop. To this I agreed. Arrangements regarding the sale of
my shop were thus made with Hwa on several occasions through
my manager and my relative named Dien Ying Ming which resulted
in a sum of $28,000.00 for the purchase of my shop, being
effected. Following which a sum of $3,000.00 was paid in
advance on the afternoon of 26-1-41 by Hwa at my shop and the
remaining $25,000.00 was to be paid on 30-1-41 A receipt for
above sum($3,000.00) was issued by me same date, and I then
had the sum($3,000.00) deposited in Sing Hua Bank, Rue Lafayette
Branch. On 30-1-41 Hwa suggested paying the remaining sum at
the Hoong Mien Restaurant, F.C. but I refused pointing out
that it was not a suitable place for handing over a large sum
of money. Hwa further promised to pay the remaining sum the
following day at my shop. The next day Hwa, instead of keeping
his promise informed me that he would come to pay the said
sum on the forenoon of 1-2-41. This day Hwa however also
failed to do. At 2 p.m. 1-2-41 detectives from Bouan Station
together with French Police came to make enquiries at my shop.
page_data.zh:
丁广圻 (Ting Kwang Shing)，28岁。
川沙人                                      自述。
老闸巡捕房          1941年2月5日。           翻译员 莫廷一 (Moo Ting I)。

我是法租界市场路75号五福堂记中药店的店主兼经营者，并居住于此。
在1940年7月盘下上述药店后，我逐渐发现难以维持经营，因为我不懂医药知识，且资金短缺。得知这一情况后，我的经理蔡子陶 (Ts Zai Ts) 建议将我的店铺卖给他的一位朋友华云水 (Hwa Fun S)，此人是欧仁·巴尔路 (Rue Eugene Bard) 上老来益中药店的副经理，急于购买一家药店。我同意了这一建议。因此，通过我的经理和我的亲戚丁英明 (Dien Ying Ming)，我与华云水多次安排店铺出售事宜，最终以28,000.00美元的价格达成购买我店铺的协议。随后，华云水于1941年1月26日下午在我的店里预付了3,000.00美元，剩余的25,000.00美元定于1941年1月30日支付。我在同日出具了上述金额（3,000.00美元）的收据，并将该笔款项（3,000.00美元）存入拉斐德路 (Rue Lafayette) 分支的新华银行。1941年1月30日，华云水建议在法租界鸿绵餐厅支付剩余款项，但我拒绝了，指出那里不适合交接大额现金。华云水又承诺第二天在我的店里支付剩余款项。然而第二天，华云水没有信守承诺，而是通知我他将于1941年2月1日上午前来支付所述款项。然而当天华云水也未履约。1941年2月1日下午2点，贝当巡捕房 (Bouan Station) 的侦探会同法国警察来到我的店里进行调查。

page_data.en:
sheet No.2

They told me that according to one of their arrests in
connection with a crime,a sum of $22,000.00 had been given to
Hwa. I had received a sum of $3,000.00 from Hwa who was the
man who was about to purchase my shop,but I did not know who
else was concerned in the transaction. I also did not know
the whereabouts of Hwa. I should further mention that following
the agreement of the sale of my shop being effected on 26-1-41
it was decided that on 27-1-41 the purchaser(Hwa) should
commence to take care of the business and Hwa despatched his
men to my shop on 27-1-41. Since the arrival of the Police
officers the men who had been despatched by Hwa left my shop
and failed to return.

Signed.Ting Kwang Shing.

他们告诉我，根据他们在一起犯罪案件中逮捕的一名嫌犯供述，有22,000.00美元给了华云水。我从准备购买我店铺的华云水那里收到了3,000.00美元，但我不知道交易中还涉及其他人。我也不知道华云水的下落。我还要补充说明，在1941年1月26日达成店铺出售协议后，决定由买方（华云水）从1941年1月27日开始接管业务，华云水于1941年1月27日派人到我的店里。自从警察到来后，华云水派来的人离开了我的店铺，并未返回。

page_data.en:
Ts Zai Tu, age 62, Ningpo.

I am employed as a manager in the Woo Foh Dong Chinese
Medicine Shop at No.75 Route Marche operated by Mr. Ting
Tsen Shing. Owing to business depression last year the
above shop was for sale. On 26/11/40 one named Wo. Hung S
assistant manager of the Iau Iai Yi Medicine Shop located
on Rue Eugene Bard who is fairly well known to me, started
negotiations regarding the sale of the medicine shop and
deciding to pay $28,000.00 for it, $3,000.00 was paid in
advance as a deposit. A receipt was issued to that effect.
All merchandise etc in the shop was checked and handed into
the care of the supervisors, about 6 in number, sent by Mr.
Wo. The $25,000.00 Woo promised to pay on the 30/1/41. He
was unable to do so on the date specified and subsequently
he guaranteed to pay at 5 p.m. on 31/1/41, he again failed
and made an appointment for 10 a.m. on 1/2/41. On the
latter date, he did not put in an appearance and at 3 p.m.,
same day Police arrived at the Shop conducting enquiries.
I informed them that Mr. Wo had been working in the Iau Iai
Yi Medicine Shop for over 20 years. After Police Investigations,
representatives sent by Mr. Wo left the shop and Wo also
disappeared.

630/
page_data.zh:
蔡子陶 (Ts Zai Tu)，62岁，宁波人。

我在丁增兴 (Ting Tsen Shing) 先生经营的市场路75号五福堂中药店担任经理。由于去年生意萧条，上述店铺挂牌出售。1940年11月26日，一位名叫华云水 (Wo. Hung S) 的人开始洽谈购买药店事宜，他是欧仁·巴尔路上老来益中药店的副经理，与我相当熟识。双方决定以28,000.00美元成交，并预付3,000.00美元作为定金。为此出具了收据。店内的所有商品等均经清点，并移交给华先生派来的约六名监盘人员保管。华先生承诺于1941年1月30日支付25,000.00美元。他在指定日期未能付款，随后保证于1941年1月31日下午5点支付，但他再次违约，并约定于1941年2月1日上午10点见面。在后一个日期，他未露面，当天下午3点，警察来到店里进行调查。我告诉他们，华先生在老来益中药店工作了二十多年。经过警方调查，华先生派来的代表离开了店铺，华先生也失踪了。

AN URGENT NOTICE TO MR. HWA PENG SU (華雲水)

CHINESE MEDICINE SHOP.
------------------------------------------

My client, the proprietor of the Woo Foh Daung
(Tsong Kyi) states the following:-

"With reference to the purchase of my shop by Mr.
Peng Su, advance money to the sum of $3,000.00
was received from him and a receipt issued on the
26th of January. Many days have elapsed, but Mr.
Hwa failed to pay the complete purchasing price,
hence the delay in handing over the shop. Also,
Mr. Hwa's present whereabouts are unknown and for
the sake of keeping confidence of commerce, you are
requested to insert a notice urging Mr. Hwa to settle
the case within three days. Failing which the procedure
of selling or purchasing the shop will be dissolved,
and the advanced money will be disposed of according
to law".

Re above, I, therefore, insert the advertisement
on behalf of my client.

关于绑架团伙逮捕案的后续报告。

对在押嫌疑人进行了进一步审讯，结果查明，在四川路绑架一名中国男子后，第二名嫌疑人收到了32,000.00美元作为其分得的赎金。

在此金额中，他将2,500.00美元投资于由第十名嫌疑人钟志诚 (Zung Tsi Sing) 经营的益丰 (Ih Fong) 棉纱号。

1941年2月5日，这2,500.00美元被移交给警方，调查显示，第十名嫌疑人接受第二名嫌疑人成为其商号的合伙人，但并不知晓这笔钱是非法所得。

对嫌疑人的继续审讯显示，第四名被告宋爱希 (Sung Iai Hysc) 与此绑架团伙毫无关系，无人指认他，也没有任何嫌疑人牵连到他。

由于没有证据 warrant 继续羁押第四名嫌疑人宋爱希以及另外两名因我报告中提到的汽车盗窃案而被拘留的人……

Doctor's certificate for Liu Pah Kwei(2nd suspect in this case
issued by Dr. Kou Yuen Ho.

On 7-12-40 one named Liu Pah Kwei, age 28, native of
Shanghai came to see me stating that he was suffering from
Hemorrhoids. An examination was made and it was found that
the Hemorrhoids were of a serious nature. An operation was
performed on him at 1 p.m. 9-12-40, and since then he has
daily been attended by me and his disease was successfully
remedied after three weeks.

P.S. According to the patient, he had become an opium smoker
as a result of suffering the above complaint. During the
interval I also cured this bad habit (opium smoking). He went
without smoking until 20-1-41. He still needs "Liver" and
"Spurmine" to be injected daily. I am sure that his health
will be fully restored in two weeks time.

Sd. Dr. Kou Yuen Ho.
page_data.zh:
刘柏桂（本案第2名嫌疑犯）的医生证明，由顾元皞医生出具。

1940年12月7日，一名名叫刘柏桂、28岁、上海籍的人士前来就诊，称患有痔疮。经检查，发现痔疮病情严重。1940年12月9日下午1时对他进行了手术，此后我每天为他诊治，三周后他的疾病成功治愈。

附注：据患者称，因患上述疾病而染上鸦片烟瘾。在此期间，我也治好了这一坏习惯（吸食鸦片）。他一直未再吸烟直至1941年1月20日。他仍需每天注射“肝精”和“ Spurmine ”。我相信他的健康将在两周内完全恢复。

签名：顾元皞医生。

Bubbling Well                     Misc.286/41          May 29th 1941.

                        Members of the National Peace Salvation
                        Army Occupying Rooms in the Paramount Hotel.

Sir;
        On receipt of information from the Paramount Hotel,
238 Yu Yuen road, at 10.55 a.m. May 29th to the effect
three rooms had been opened by members of the National
Peace Salvation Army some of whom bore arms, Inspector
Parker, the undersigned and a party of detectives
proceeded to the scene with a view interviewing this
party. On arrival at the entrance a car was being
boarded by several male Chinese in plain clothes whilst
the last man to enter was in uniform and carrying a
drawn pistol. The car drove off west along Yu Yuen
road before Police could check up on them.
        At the Hotel Desk it was ascertained rooms Nos.
401 and 403 had been taken a few minutes previously
by the party just left. Room No.301 had been taken on
the afternoon of May 28th and according to the clerk
was still occupied.
        The Police party visited room 301 and found it
occupied by Han Tzu Sz (韓半氏) wife of Han Wei San
(韓衛三), Commander of the 56th Regiment, 12th Brigade
of the National Peace Salvation Army, his headquarters
being at Pei Chan (北) Temple, North of Shanghai, and under
command Ting Shih Hsin (丁世新). Apparently she did not
wish to be questioned and having gone into the bathroom re-
fused to do so.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / MAY 30 1941 / SPECIAL BRANCH）

（批：PHS / CA）

静安寺                     杂项 286/41          1941年5月29日。

                        占据百乐门旅馆房间的全国和平救国军成员。

先生：
        5月29日上午10时55分，接到愚园路238号百乐门旅馆的情报，
称全国和平救国军成员开了三个房间，其中一些人携带武器，
帕克（Parker）巡官、本人及一队警探随即前往现场，
旨在与该伙人会面。到达入口处时，几名便衣中国男子
正在上一辆汽车，最后一名上车者身穿制服并手持出鞘手枪。
在警方进行核查之前，该车已沿愚园路向西驶离。
        在旅馆前台查实，刚刚离开的那伙人于几分钟前
入住了401和403号房间。301号房间于5月28日下午入住，
据职员称仍有人居住。
        警方一行人探访了301号房间，发现居住者为韩半氏（Han Tzu Sz），
系全国和平救国军第十二旅第五十六团团长韩卫三（Han Wei San）之妻，
该团总部设在上海北面的北禅（Pei Chan）寺，受丁世新（Ting Shih Hsin）指挥。
显然她不愿接受询问，进入浴室后
拒绝出来。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 1941年5月30日 / 特别处）

（批：PHS / CA）

Two male Chinese arrested by Reserve Unit Search Party in possession
of Chinese Military Uniform.
D.S.I. Suhoff.

At 10.45 p.m. on 20-3-41, F.P.S. 205 Nicolsky
in charge of the Reserve Unit Search Party operating
in Louza district, which party consisted of S.P.C.s
574 and 83 and C.T.Cs. 2186, 423 and 978, brought
to this station two male Chinese named:-
(1) Sung K'ung Sung (孫空生) age 24, native of Wusih,
S/clerk employed at the Reformed Government, Peace
Construction Army at Quinsan, and
(2) Ong Ngon Ging (翁元琴) age 43, native of
Soochow, S/clerk employed at the Reformed Govern-
ment, Peace Construction Army at Quinsan,
whom this party had arrested at 10.30 p.m. 20-3-41
at the corner of Chekiang and Hankow Roads, in
possession of two suits of Chinese military uniform.
The 2nd named man carried a parcel wrapped in
a piece of cloth containing two tunics, two pair of
pants, one belt and one great coat. On the tunics were
attached the identification cards of the two men.
Questioned by detectives the two arrested men
stated that at about 5 p.m. on 20-3-41 they obtained
two days' leave, and at about 8 p.m. same date they
left Quinsan by train for Shanghai.
In order not to pay the train fare $1.80 they
travelled in military uniform and on arrival to the
North Railway Station they changed the uniform for
civil clothing and were walking intending to find a
room in one of the hotels or lodging houses in the
Settlement when they were arrested by the Search Party.
The facts of this case were brought before the
Senior Inspector in charge who set on the instructions

1941年3月20日晚上10点45分，负责在老闸区行动的后备队搜查组的巡捕房警员（F.P.S.）205号 Nicolsky，该小组由上海华捕（S.P.C.）574号和83号以及中国籍便衣探员（C.T.C.）2186号、423号和978号组成，将两名中国男子带至本警局，姓名如下：
(1) 孙空生 (Sung K'ung Sung)，24岁，无锡人，受雇于昆山维新政府和平建国军，任下级职员，及
(2) 翁元琴 (Ong Ngon Ging)，43岁，苏州人，受雇于昆山维新政府和平建国军，任下级职员，
该小组于1941年3月20日晚上10点30分在浙江路与汉口路转角处逮捕了上述二人，当时他们持有两套中国军服。第二名男子携带一个用布包裹的包裹，内有两件上衣、两条裤子、一条腰带和一件大衣。上衣上附有这两人的身份证。
经侦探讯问，两名被捕男子称，1941年3月20日下午5点左右他们获准休假两天，同日晚上8点左右他们乘火车从昆山前往上海。
为了节省1.80美元的车费，他们身穿军服乘车，抵达北站后将军服换为便服，正打算在租界内的某家旅馆或寄宿处寻找房间时被搜查组逮捕。

COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE.

Translation of a despatch No. 24 from the 11th Independent Column Headquarters
of the Peace Salvation Army

February 25, 1941.

The Police Headquarters,
S. M. P.

Sirs,

As this Headquarters has been established for a
long time, the official badges and identity cards
formerly issued by us for identification purposes
might be lost or be used by those unscrupulous per-
sons who commit fraud under false pretences. With
a view to preventing the irregularities, we have issued
to all officers and ranks new identity cards for iden-
tifying their respective offices, a specimen copy of
which is forwarded to you for the general information
of your subordinates.

Those who are in possession of the new identity
cards will be, in case of any trouble caused to them,
identified themselves as the officers or ranks of this
Headquarters. Otherwise, they are falsely represented
and must be taken into custody and be subject to inter-
rogation.

As the matter concerns the military discipline,
you are, therefore, requested to place it on record.

Commander Lee Ti-sung
2nd Commander Chang Tien-ming.

和平救国军第十一独立支队司令部第24号公函译文

1941年2月25日。

致：
上海公共租界工部局警务处总部。

先生们：

鉴于本司令部成立已久，此前由我方签发用于身份识别的官方徽章和身份证可能遗失，或被不法分子利用进行欺诈活动。为防止此类违规行为，我们已向所有官兵签发新的身份证以识别其各自职务，现随函附上样本一份，供贵方下属普遍知悉。

持有新身份证者在遇到麻烦时，可凭此证明其为本人即为本司令部的军官或士兵。否则，即为假冒，必须予以拘留并接受审讯。

由于此事涉及军纪，故请贵方备案。

司令 李迪松 (Lee Ti-sung)
副司令 张天明 (Chang Tien-ming)。

5th January, 41,

Re two Chinese military officers visiting
Mee Koo Mei Cafe in uniform.

At 8.15 p.m. 5/1/41 a telephone message was
received at the station from the Mee Koo Mei (米高美)
Cafe, 447 Yu Ya Ching Road, reporting the admittance
of two Chinese soldiers in uniform.

S.I. Glanville attended and brought to the station
the following:-

1. General Yue Shun Chih (俞人傑), of the
National Salvation Army for Peace, Headquarters
at 900 Chung Hwa Road, Nantao, and
2. General Yang Hou Zu (楊後祖), with
Headquarters in Tungehow.

The former was seen carrying a sword of Japanese
style and a Browning auto. .32 pistol, a firearm permit
No. 3271 S.M.P. issued to him on 3/12/40 being in his
possession.

Both were wearing Officer's uniform, and when ques-
tioned by Chief Inspector Blenkinsop, Officer i/c, stated
that after attending a party in Hongkew held by Japanese
Authorities, they proceeded in a private M/car Lic. No.
2588 to the Union Theatre, 447 Yu Ya Ching Road.

As the show commenced at 9.15 p.m., they went into
the Mee Koo Mei Cafe, which is located at the rear of the
Theatre building, to spend the remainder of the time.
They stated that owing to the fact that they were ignorant
of the Cafe and the theatre being situated within the U.S.
Marines Defence Sector, they arrived there in uniform.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH）
（批：Cy 1/1/41）

关于两名中国军官身着军服访问米高美咖啡馆一事。

1941年1月5日晚上8点15分，警局接到位于虞洽卿路447号的米高美 (Mee Koo Mei) 咖啡馆的电话报告，称有两名身着军服的中国士兵进入店内。

高级督察 Glanville 到场处理，并将以下人员带至警局：

1. 俞人傑 (Yue Shun Chih) 将军，隶属和平救国军，总部设在南市中华路900号，及
2. 楊後祖 (Yang Hou Zu) 将军，总部设在通州 (Tungehow)。

前者被发现携带一把日式军刀和一支勃朗宁 .32 口径自动手枪，其持有工部局警务处于1940年12月3日签发的第3271号持枪证。

两人都穿着军官制服，当受到主管首席督察 Blenkinsop 的讯问时，他们陈述称，在参加完由日本当局在虹口举行的聚会后，他们乘坐一辆牌照号为 2588 的私人汽车前往位于虞洽卿路447号的联合大戏院 (Union Theatre)。

由于演出将于晚上9点15分开始，他们进入位于戏院大楼后方的米高美咖啡馆消磨剩余时间。他们声称，由于不知道咖啡馆和戏院位于美国海军陆战队防区内，因此身着军服到达此地。

Further to letter purporting to have emanated from
the Peace Salvation Army received at 8/666 Tiendong Rd.

Sir,

At 10 a.m. 30-11-40, the compt. visited this
station and reported having been the recipient of a
further letter which he had received at about 7 p.m.
24-11-40 at his home. The letter which came from the
same source as the previous one, is translated as
follows:-

"Zee Zai Tseu has twice failed to appear at this
office to answer the charge of causing the death of
his wife, ill-treating his mother and bigamy. In
accordance with Article 2 Section 5 of the Martial
Law, death penalty is imposed on the offender, and
officers in the district concerned have been notified
to execute at any time. Zee Zai Tseu and his two sons
are to note".

Chopped: Judge Peu Yau.
H'qtrs. of Peace Salvation Army.
Dated 23-11-40.

Between 20-11-40 and 29-11-40, the compt. was away
from Shanghai and thus delayed reporting to the Police.

Further enquiries amongst friends and relatives who
are not suspected by the compt. revealed that the compt's
wife died on 3-12-39 after a long sickness.

At 4.25 p.m. November 9, P.S. 614 noticed
four men quarrelling on North Szechuen Road near Dixwell

Interrogated at the station, the men gave

由 副督察长 Young 制作 经由 警司 Mason 转发

11月9日下午4点25分，警局警员（P.S.）614号注意到四名男子在靠近狄思威路的北四川路上争吵，并将他们带到狄思威路警察局。
在警局受审时，这些人报出的姓名如下：
投诉人：陈招生 (Chen Chao-sun)，16岁，江湾人；朱金弟 (Tsu Kyung-dee)，也是江湾人。
被告：(1) 孫志剛 (Sung Ts-kong)，29岁，镇江人，已婚，居住在华界胡家宅路 (Hu Ka Zah Road) 289号；(2) 李如桃 (Lee Zu-dao)，30岁，扬州人，是第一被告雇佣的代理人。
投诉人称，当他们从江湾运送一批棉花到上海时，遇到了两名自称是侦探的被告，并向他们索要5美元。他们向被告提供了身上仅有的1美元，但由于后者不满意，随即发生争吵。
两名被告否认指控，称他们正在搜查两名投诉人是否携带枪支，因为西区发生过一起将枪支藏在棉花中的案件。
在第一被告身上发现一枚徽章，显示他是和平建国军第二集团总司令部谍查处特务股 (Special Service Section of the Second Group Headquarters of the National Reconstruction Army through Peace) 的成员，办公地点位于南市泥滨路 (Ni Ying Road)；被告承认

November 19, 1940.

Letter purporting to have emanated from the Peace Salvation
Army received at 8/666 Tiendong Road.

With reference to the attached W.H. Misc.
Report No.450/40 on the subject of the Peace Salvation
Army having on 26/10/40, delivered a letter to one
Zee Zai Tseu (徐善斋) residing at Lane 666/8
Tiendong Road, instructing the recipient to appear
before the Martial Law Office of the Army on November
1, 2 and 3 to answer certain charges etc., enquiries
however failed to confirm that such an office exists
at the address indicated in the letter. This will be
explained by the fact that the address - Siso Mo Jao,
Zia Tu Road, Nantao, (southern extention of Route
Delastre, French Concession) - as stated in the letter
is located within the area where martial law is being
enforced by the Japanese Military in Nantao, thereby
rendering it impossible for any person other than a
Japanese to enter the area in question.
Enquiries from an indirect source also failed
to show that such an office exists at the locality
referred to above.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE NOV 19 1940 ASSISTANT COMMISSIONER SPECIAL BRANCH）

1940年11月19日。

在天潼路8/666号收到一封据称发自“和平救国军”的信件。

关于附件中的华捕杂项报告第450/40号，该报告涉及“和平救国军”于1940年10月26日向居住在天潼路666弄8号的徐善斋（Zee Zai Tseu）递交一信一事，信中指示收信人于11月1日、2日和3日到该军军法处报到，以回应某些指控等。然而，经查询未能证实信函所指地址存在此类机构。这一情况可由以下事实解释：信函中所述的地址——南市霞土路四所庙角（Siso Mo Jao, Zia Tu Road, Nantao，即法租界达拉司脱路向南延伸段）——位于日军在南市实施戒严的区域之内，因此除日本人外，任何人无法进入该区域。
通过间接渠道进行的查询也未能显示上述地点存在此类机构。

Sir,
On the morning of 12-11-40, as a result of
questioning by D.I. Kao Ten Ken (Special Branch) the
following has been ascertained. The 1st arrested
man, Miao Vung (缪南) stated that between 1927 and
1939 he held various ranks in the Central Government
Army under Chiang Kai Shek. However after the fall
of Nanking, he took the position of Chief Detective
in the International Private Detective Agency, 367
Kiangssi Road and used this position as a blind to
facilitate his movements as a guerilla. Later
various member of this agency were arrested by
French Police in connection with an extortion case
and Miao Vung was implicated. In order to escape arrest,
he gave himself up to the Japanese Authorities and
later became a member of the Wang Ching Wei Army.
Statement attached.

The four arrested men were finger printed but
they were found to have no previous convictions.

A detailed list of papers and property found in
Room 207 is attached.

The four men and one female are at present
detained at the Station pending further instructions.

Misc. 739/40.
Miao Yung (繆勇) alias Miao Loong Sung
(繆尤声). // D.I. Kao Yen Ken (Sp.Br).
Chengchow.
Louza Stn. 12-11-40.

I am aged 45 a native of Changchow and married. I
am the Deputy Commander-in-Chief of the Peace Alliance Army
with a headquarters at Nanking and offices at 73 Chao Foong
Tsung, Yu Yuen Road O.O.L. and in the New Asia Hotel, Tien-
dong Road. This army consists of 40,000 men fully equipped
and divided into 4 "armies". Concurrently I hold the
post of the Commander of the 4th Army of the Peace Alliance
Army comprising of 23,000 men now stationed at Changchow,
Wusieh, Juinsan, Tsingpu and Pootung. I have my headquarters
at Juinsan. Arrangements are being made by me to establish
a Shanghai Office of the 4th Army at 47 Yai Kou Ka, Nantao.

After being educated in the Changchow Provincial Middle
School, Changchow, I proceeded with my relatives to Manchuria
where I served as a Major in General Chang Hsueh-liang's
Army. That was in 1927. After 8 months, I joined the
Central Military Academy Branch at Hankow. In 1929 I
graduated from the academy and later served as Chief Adjutant
(副官主任) in the North Hankow Garrison Headquarters
(漢口北區要塞司令部). In 1931 (Dec.) when the army was disbanded
I came to Shanghai and became the Chief Adjutant of the
Woosung Fort Garrison Headquarters (吳淞要塞司令部), which
was dissolved during a Sino-Japanese Conflict in 1932.

Soon later I was employed as the comprador of the
S.S. "Tasimo" (塔知) of Messrs Jardine Matheson for a
year. (Shanghai-Hankow Line).

In 1934, I again proceeded to Hankow and joined the
50th Army of the Central Army under General Wei Li-huang
page_data.zh:
杂项 739/40.
缪勇（Miao Yung），别名缪尤声（Miao Loong Sung）。// 特科督察高延肯（Kao Yen Ken，音译）。
常州。
老闸分局 1940年11月12日。

我现年45岁，常州人，已婚。我是和平同盟军副总司令，总部设在南京，办事处位于欧战路（O.O.L.）兆丰总路73号及天潼路新亚酒店。该军拥有全副武装人员4万名，分为4个“军”。同时，我兼任和平同盟军第四军军长，该军现有23,000人，驻扎在常州、无锡、昆山（Juinsan，音译）、青浦和浦东。我的总部设在昆山（Juinsan，音译）。我正安排在南市雅勾街（Yai Kou Ka，音译）47号设立第四军上海办事处。

我在常州省立中学接受教育后，随亲属前往满洲，在张学良将军的军队中担任少校。那是1927年。8个月后，我加入了汉口中央军事学院分校。1929年我从军校毕业，随后在汉口北区要塞司令部担任副官主任。1931年12月，随着部队解散，我来到上海，成为吴淞要塞司令部的副官主任，该司令部在1932年的中日冲突期间被撤销。

不久之后，我被怡和洋行雇佣为“塔知”号（S.S. "Tasimo"，音译）轮船的买办，为期一年。（上海-汉口航线）。

1934年，我再次前往汉口，加入了魏立煌（Wei Li-huang，音译）将军统领的中央军第五十军

page_data.en:
Sheet 2.

(魏漁三) as Commander of the 3rd Regiment, 7th Brigade
of the 1st Division.
In 1937, when Sino-Japanese hostilities again broke
out in Shanghai, I was transferred to Shanghai. Then I
served as the Commander of the 3rd Brigade, 45th Division
of the 7th Army under General Tang Sung Ts(唐生智).
When Shanghai and Nanking was lost and occupied by the
Japanese, I became the Commander-in-Chief of the Kiangsu-
Chekiang-Anhwei Eastern Route Guerrilla Unit(苏浙皖东区游击队)
with 13,000 men along the Shanghai Nanking Railway. That
unit was under the instructions of General Tai Chih(戴戟)
(General Chiang Kai Shek's man).
Meanwhile, in order to facilitate my movements in
Shanghai, I operated with a Portuguese named Silva/the
Wu Chow(International Private Detectives' Agency, 367 Kiangse
Road and served as a herbalist with an office at 83 Kwangse
Road. Owing that some of the private detectives committed
an extortion case in the French Concession and the French
Police arrested and convicted 4 of the detectives and
attempted to arrest me and further that the Japanese
authorities also endeavoured to arrest me, I surrendered to the
Commander Hung Kwei Yung(黄文) of the Peace Alliance
Army, who appointed me to my present posts. On the recommen-
dation of Commander Hung, I was appointed "General" by
the Nanking Government,(Wang Ching Wei), I usually stay
in Tainan.
On October 24, 1940 I came to Shanghai with six officers

Sec 09882
page_data.zh:
第2页。

（魏漁三）任第一师第七旅第三团团长。
1937年，当中日战事再次在上海爆发时，我被调往上海。随后，我在唐生智将军麾下第七军第四十五师担任第三旅旅长。当上海和南京失守并被日军占领后，我成为苏浙皖东区游击队总司令，率领一万三千人沿京沪铁路活动。该部队受戴戟将军（蒋介石的人）指挥。
同时，为了便于我在上海行动，我与一名名为Silva/the Wu Chow的葡萄牙人合作（国际私人侦探社，江西路367号），并在广西路83号开设诊所担任草药医师。由于该私家侦探社的一些侦探在法租界犯下敲诈勒索案，法国警察逮捕并定罪了4名侦探，并试图逮捕我，加之日本当局也企图逮捕我，我便向和平联盟军司令黄文投降，后者任命我担任现职。经黄司令推荐，我被南京政府（汪精卫）任命为“将军”，我通常居住在台南。
1940年10月24日，我带着六名军官来到上海

Sec 09882

page_data.en:
Sheet 3.

and stayed in the Great Shanghai Hotel, Tientsin Road. I
had an instruction from the Commander-in-Chief of the
Peace Alliance Army to take part in Major Fu Shiao An's
Funeral Procession on October 27.

On October 26, I received 9 suits of uniform for
officers and 24 for soldiers from the Shanghai Office on
Yu Yuen Road. On October 27, I together with 6 officers
and 3 guards all in uniform attended the funeral procession.
Following the funeral service, the officers and men left
for their billets. I am now keeping the uniform for men
to be posted in the New Nantao Office of my army.

I also have instructions to move 1000 of my men to
Chow Ka Jao, off Warren Road in the Western District to
be served as guards to the New Major Chen Kung Poh. He
is to arrive at Shanghai to assume the new post on November
12 or 13 but no definite information has been received.
Some one hundred coloured paper posters bearing slogans
welcoming the New Major have been prepared by members of my
Political Section. They were in my room in the Great Shanghai
Hotel and arrangements were made to have them exhibited in
the New Civic Centre, Nantao, Chapel and Jessfield Village
on Nov. 12.

My elder brother is General Mieu Bei Man( 缪培南 ),
under General Chiang Kai Shek, and his men are now stationed
at Kwangming( 光明 ).
page_data.zh:
第3页。

并住在天津路的大上海酒店。我接到和平联盟军总司令的指令，要求参加10月27日傅筱庵少将的葬礼游行。

10月26日，我从豫园路上海办事处领取了9套军官制服和24套士兵制服。10月27日，我与6名军官和3名卫兵均身着制服参加了葬礼游行。葬礼仪式结束后，官兵们返回各自的驻地。目前我正保管着士兵制服，以便配发至我军新南市办事处。

我还接到指令，将我的一千名士兵调往西区华伦路附近的周家角（Chow Ka Jao），担任新任市长陈公博的警卫。他将于11月12日或13日抵达上海就任新职，但尚未收到确切消息。我的政治处成员已准备了约一百张印有欢迎新市长标语的彩色纸质海报。这些海报存放在我位于大上海酒店的房间内，并已安排于11月12日在新市中心、南市、教堂和极司菲尔村（Jessfield Village）展示。

我的兄长是缪培南将军，隶属蒋介石将军麾下，其部队目前驻扎在光明。

警督 Suhoff。

先生，
1940年11月12日凌晨1点，由警佐Turner、高级警员196号、高级警员78号及本人组成的侦探小组，在执行酒店搜查任务时，进入了天津路423号大上海酒店的207室。
在房内发现四名中国男性和一名中国女性，对房间的搜查发现了大量军服、小册子、军事徽章、文件和印章。
这五人被带到本分局进行讯问。他们的具体情况如下：-
(1) Mico Vung (缪 闻 ) 45岁，漳州，南京政府第四路军中将。
(2) Mico Sung Sz (缪 沈 氏 ) 37岁，宁波，女性，上述男子的妻子。
(3) Wong Tsoh Yun (王 竹 韻 ) 47岁，江阴，秘书，上述将军的秘书。
(4) Koong Siao Zung (宮 小 成 ) 26岁，安徽，苦力，受雇于第一名男子。
(5) Wong Zau Yoong (王 灶 荣 ) 21岁，苏州，苦力，受雇于第一名男子。
以下物品在房内被查获并带至本分局，
24件士兵上衣，
23条“裤子，
25顶“帽子，
7件军官上衣，
7条“裤子，
1件未完成的军官上衣。
2顶军官帽，
5副绑腿，
9条军用腰带，
1个装有军事徽章的纸箱，
一批关于宋庆龄被任命为军事委员会主席的小册子。
1把雨伞，
1支手电筒，以及
1个小手提箱，内装各种军事文件和地图。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处特科 1940年11月17日）

sheet 2.

questioned by detectives, the last named arrested
men, Miao Yung, stated that he is the Vice-Commander-in-
Chief of the League Peace Army, Headquarters 73 Jessfield
Road and concurrently the Commander of 4th Route Army
which consists of 35,000 soldiers and is stationed
in Kiangsu Province.

The General, Miao Yung, arrived in Shanghai on
21-10-40 with his wife, secretary and two servants named
above, and engaged Room 207 of the Grand Shanghai Hotel.
He stated that being chief supporter of the new
appointed Mayor of Shanghai, Chen Koong Poh, he came
to Shanghai to celebrate the Mayor's appointment.
He further stated that the 4th Route Army under his
command would be transferred to Shanghai, and he was
preparing with the assistance of the local authorities
at 73 Jessfield Road the quarters for his army and his
offices at Nantao. The seized uniform and documents
were supplied by officials from 73 Jessfield Road.

Being afraid of an attempt on his life, the
General registered his name in the Hotel guest book
as Wong Shing Chi (黄鑫记) age 48, native of Taicang
merchant.

The Special Branch were informed but at the
time when this report was made the arrested persons
have not been questioned yet by the members of the
Special Branch. The first named persons are being
detained pending instructions from Headquarters. The
second named will be questioned immediately about
and the source of supply of the uniforms and documents.

经侦探讯问，最后提到的被捕男子缪闻声称，他是和平联盟军副总司令，总部设在极司菲尔路73号，同时兼任第四路军司令，该路军拥有三万五千名士兵，驻扎在江苏省。

缪闻将军于1940年10月21日与其妻子、秘书及上述两名仆人抵达上海，并入住大上海酒店207室。他声称，作为新任上海市长陈公博的主要支持者，他来上海是为了庆祝市长的就职。
他还表示，他指挥下的第四路军将调往上海，他正在极司菲尔路73号当地当局的协助下，为其军队和在南市设立的办公室准备营房。被查获的制服和文件是由极司菲尔路73号的官员提供的。

因担心有人暗杀，将军在酒店旅客登记簿上登记的姓名为黄鑫记，48岁，太仓籍商人。

特科已获知此事，但在撰写本报告时，特科成员尚未讯问被捕人员。第一名被捕者正被拘留，等待总部指示。第二名被捕者将立即接受关于制服和文件来源的讯问。

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.

Letter purporting to have emanated from the Peace Salvation Army received at 8/666 Tiendong Road.

Sir,

At 2.20 p.m. 31-10-40, one named Zee Zai Tseu (徐善斋), Chinese style doctor, residing at 8/666 Tiendong Road, came to the station and reported having been the recipient of a letter drawn up in the form of a "Summons", ordering him to appear at the Martial Law Office of the Peace Salvation Army, situated at Siau Mo Jao (小木桥), Zia Too Road, Nantao. The said letter was delivered by post at 5 p.m. 26-10-40 (post mark indecipherable). A translation is as follows:-

"Zee Zai Tseu, who has caused the death of his wife, cohabited with a paramour and ill-treated his mother, is to appear at the Martial Law Office of the Peace Salvation Army, Siau Mo Jao, Zia Too Road, Nantao, on the afternoon of 1st, 2nd or 3rd of November 1940, to be tried on the above charges. Martial Law will be meted out should he ignore this summons.
Chopped:- Pau Yau.
H'qtrs of Peace Salvation Army"

Questioned, the complainant states his wife died from natural causes at the end of 1939, but denied the other charges. On being informed if he was desirous of Police protection, he declined the offer. However, he has been instructed to report any further developments.

Forwarded for information.

S & C G

(印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE 27 SEPT. 1940 COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE)

A Shanghai Office was recently established
by the 12th Route Army of the Peace & National
Reconstruction Army of the Nanking Government, in
the Hunan Guild (湖南會館), St. Catherine's
Bridge, Nantao. The office was, however, closed
by the Japanese military authorities at 6.30 p.m.
September 24. Some 30 rifles were seized and all
the members, numbering more than 100, were ordered
to leave the guild. The signboard that was hung
outside the guild premises was also taken away.
No arrest was made.

It is learned that the disbandment was
effected because its members consisted mostly
of undesirables, who were engaged in corrupt
practices, such as fraud, extortion etc.

Pan Lien-pih
D. I.

南京政府和平建国军第十二路军最近在南市圣凯瑟琳桥的湖南会馆设立了一个上海办事处。然而，该办事处于9月24日下午6点30分被日本军方当局关闭。约30支步枪被没收，所有成员（超过100人）被命令离开会馆。悬挂在会馆外的招牌也被带走。无人被捕。

据悉，解散是因为其成员大多为不良分子，从事欺诈、敲诈勒索等腐败行为。

On July 1, 1940, a temporary office was
established by the "Independent 4th Division
of the 5th Route Army of the Central Peace
and National Salvation Army," at 900 Chung Hwa
Road, Nantao, the former premises of the Ming
Lih Middle School.

The Commander-in-Chief is one named Tsau
Tsung Hwei (趙振輝) and the Divisional
Officer is one named Tsang Tien Ming (張天民);
both men were previously officers in Marshal
Sung Chuen Faung's army. They spend most
of their time in Tungchow where the Divisional
and Army Headquarters are located and may visit
the Shanghai temporary office on occasions.

This army which consists of 2,000 men
at present was organized under the sponsorship
of the Japanese Military with a view to utilizing
its personnel for the buying over of Chinese
guerillas operating in Japanese occupied areas,
and has not as yet obtained official recognition
from the "Nanking Government."

They have no regular remuneration but
depend on rewards from the Japanese Military
when they are successful in buying over guerilla
bands. This money is not sufficient for their

instructions from Commander-in-Chief Zau (邹), a temporary

At 9.45 a.m. on 6/7/40 a telephone message
was received from C.P.C.559 reporting that three
armed robbers had been shot on Jessfield Road near
the rear gate 88 Jessfield Road. D.I. Tabrum and party immediately attended and from subsequent
enquiries the following was ascertained.

At about 9.40 a.m. on 6/6/40 the complainant
Yue Bui Yeong (虞培荣), a coolie employed by the
Fah Kee (发记) Transportation Co. 674 North See-
chow Road, was passing westwards on Jessfield Road
enroute from 674, North Soochow Road to Fah Sing
Kying where he intended delivering certain documents
to the headah of a boat.

On arriving a point near the rear entrance of
Jessfield Park, the three accused, who were loitering
at the roadside, stepped into the path of the ricksha
and the 1st accused Tsang S Hyoon produced a pistol
and ordered the ricksha puller to stop. He obeyed the
order and set down the shafts of the vehicle and at
the same time the complainant stood up on the
footboard.

Whilst the 2nd accused Yang Hou Jung and the
3rd, accused Dah Sung Tz (deceased) stood on either
side of the ricksha, the 1st accused Tsang S Hyoon
threatened the complt. with his pistol and made him
sit down. He then searched the complainant's
pockets and from his right waistcoat pocket he
removed two one dollar notes, a three part China
National Savings Cert. and a lighter. These articles
by them placed in the one bag.

1940年7月6日 上午9:45，接到中央巡捕房559号电话报告，称在极司菲尔路88号后门附近有三名武装劫匪被击毙。副督察塔布鲁姆（Tabrum）及其随行人员立即赶赴现场，经后续调查查明如下情况。

1940年6月6日（原文如此，应为7月6日）上午9:40左右，报案人虞培荣（Yue Bui Yeong），系发记运输公司雇员，住址苏州河北路674号，正沿极司菲尔路向西行进，从苏州河北路674号前往法兴庆（Fah Sing Kying，音译），打算向船头交付某些文件。

当到达极司菲尔公园后门附近的一点时，三名在路边徘徊的被告走到黄包车前，第一被告张世元（Tsang S Hyoon）掏出手枪，命令车夫停车。车夫服从命令，放下车杠，同时报案人站在踏脚板上。

当第二被告杨孝仁（Yang Hou Jung）和第三被告大成子（Dah Sung Tz，死者）站在黄包车两侧时，第一被告张世元用手枪威胁报案人，迫使他坐下。随后他搜查了报案人的口袋，从其右侧马甲口袋中取出了两张一美元纸币、一张三联式中国国家储蓄证书和一个打火机。这些物品被他们放入同一个袋子中。

In the meanwhile, S.I. Li Shu Fa, C.P.C.559, 2500
and 3021 who were on plain clothes duty in the Jessfield
Park had observed a Park coolie looking intently through
the bamboo fence separating the Park from Jessfield Road.
They proceeded to ascertain the cause of his interest
and observed the three accused acting in a suspicious
manner on Jessfield Road. They then made their way
through the rear gate heading to Jessfield Road, and at
a point about twenty yards westward they observed the
three accused standing around a stationary ricksha. The
complainant was standing on the footboard being searched
by the 1st accused Tsang Ts Bien who was armed with a
pistol whilst the 2nd accused Dah Sung Ts (deceased)
were standing close by.

S.I.Li ordered his party to separate and approach
the group and then ordered the three accused not to move
and to put up their hands. The 2nd accused Tang Keu Zung
and the 3rd accused Dah Sung Ts attempted to abscond
whilst the 1st accused Tsang Ts Bien made no sign of
complying with the order and appeared about to resist.

S.I. Li and party then opened fire and brought all
three accused to the ground before they could return fire.

No. 59 & 65 West End Gardens.

On 13-3-40, a letter addressed to French Police by
a person signing himself Neo Sun Ching ( ) was
forwarded to this station. In it the writer relates
that No.59 West End Gardens is the rendezvous of
kidnappers and alleges that the occupants kidnapped two
Sush merchants named Ning Kwang Han (任光漢) and
Mak Fong Jih (麥邦傑) and was demanding $300,000.00
ransom.

Prior to this, on 9-2-40, this station dealt with
a case in which a Chinese female, Sung Mei Ying (宋美英)
attempted to commit suicide by drinking Lysol (Misc.96/
4C B. .) at this address.

On the morning of 24-2-40, Mr. F.W. Thomas, General
Secretary of the British Forces, Y.M.C.A., who resides
at 57 West End Gardens, reported to this station that
on the previous evening he had seen one of the Chinese
male occupants of No.65 West End Gardens return home in
a ricksha. He appeared to be drunk and either did not
pay his fare or failed to pay sufficient and when the
ricksha coolie expostulated with him he produced a pistol
and threatened him. Other inmates of the house came out
and took away his pistol, after which they searched him
and took him into the house.

A S.S.M.P. Constable, who was on duty nearby
heard the ricksha coolie shout.

西端花园（West End Gardens）59号和65号。

1940年3月13日，一封署名为聂新清（Neo Sun Ching，音译）的人写给法国警察的信被转至本警署。信中写信人称，西端花园59号是绑匪的聚集地，并指控住户绑架了两名苏州商人，名为任光汉（Ning Kwang Han）和麦邦杰（Mak Fong Jih），并索要300,000.00美元赎金。

在此之前，1940年2月9日，本警署处理了一起案件，一名中国女子宋美英（Sung Mei Ying）在该地址饮用来苏水（Lysol）企图自杀（杂项96/4C B. .）。

1940年2月24日上午，居住在西区花园57号的英国青年会总干事F.W.托马斯（F.W. Thomas）先生向本警署报告，称前一晚他看到西端花园65号的一名中国男性住户坐黄包车回家。他看起来喝醉了，要么没付车费，要么付的钱不够，当黄包车夫与他理论时，他掏出手枪进行威胁。屋内的其他住客出来夺下了他的手枪，随后对他进行了搜身并将他带进屋内。

一名 nearby 执勤的上海公共租界工部局警务处巡捕听到了黄包车夫的喊叫声。

（批：移交 / J.K.Dun / 1940年3月28日）

D.S. Hide.
translated
July 5th., 1940
XXXXX

My name is Yue Bei Yoong. I am a native of Wusih and am
employed as a coolie by the Fah Kee Transportation Co., 674
North Soochow Road.

At about 8.00a.m. on July 6th. 1940, in accordance with
my daily routine I set out to deliver some tax stamps and
documents to the loadah of a boat lying in Soochow Creek at
Poh Sing Kyung. I proceeded by bus to a point on Jessfield
Road near Brenan Road where I engaged a ricsha to complete the
journey.

On arriving at a point on Jessfield Road near the rear en-
trance to Jessfield Road, when three male Chinese who were
loitering on the left side of the roadway, stepped into the
thepath of the ricsha and speaking in Shanghai dialect all
ordered the ricsha to stop saying "Taung-po-taho ding-la-le,
Veh yau deung" and at the same time I saw that one of them
dressed in white clothing carrying a pistol which he held in a
threatening attitude.

The ricsha puller immediately stopped and placed the shafts
on the ground and I stood upright on the footboard. The armed
man then approached closer and holding his pistol in one hand
he search my pockets with the other and removed two one dollar
notes, one three cents bus token and a letter from my right
outside jacket pocket and placed these articles in his own left
outside jacket pocket. In the meanwhile the other two robbers
were standing at the side of the ricsha but did not say or do
anything.

Although

D.S. Hide.

1940年7月5日
XXXXX

我叫 Yue Bei Yoong。我是无锡人，受雇于苏州北路674号 Fah Kee 运输公司，担任苦力。

1940年7月6日上午8时许，按照我的日常惯例，我出发向停泊在波辛泾（Poh Sing Kyung）苏州河上的一艘船的船老大送达一些印花税票和文件。我乘公共汽车前往极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road）靠近布伦南路（Brenan Road）的一处地点，随后雇用了一辆人力车完成余下路程。

当到达极司菲尔路靠近极司菲尔路后入口的一处地点时，三名在道路左侧闲逛的中国男子走到人力车前，用上海话齐声喝令人力车停下，说道：“汤婆子定勒勒，勿要动”，同时我看到其中一名身穿白衣的男子手持手枪，摆出威胁姿态。

人力车夫立即停车并将车杠放在地上，我站在踏板上直起身子。持枪男子随即走近，一手持枪，另一手搜查我的口袋，从我右侧外衣口袋中拿走了两张一元纸币、一枚三分公交车代币和一封信，并将这些物品放入他自己左侧的外衣口袋中。与此同时，另外两名劫匪站在人力车旁，未发一言也未做任何动作。

虽然

page_data.en:
Continued (2)

Although I had not raised an alarm, at this juncture three
or four male Chinese who afterwards proved to be Policemen, appeared from behind and at each side of the ricksha and opened fire on the three robbers and brought them all three to the ground.

I was later escorted to Bubbling Well Station where I was shown three lots of bank notes one of which included a three cents bus token. In this lot of $3.20 I picked out one reddish and blueish coloured dollar note which are similar to those stolen by the armed robber. The three cents bus token also appears to be mine.

Whilst in the Station I also saw a male Chinese whom I recognised as one of the two unarmed robbers.

(Sgd.) Yee Bei Yeong.
page_data.zh:
续（2）

虽然我没有发出警报，但就在此时，三四名后来证实为警察的中国男子从人力车后方及两侧出现，向三名劫匪开火，将他们全部击倒在地。

随后我被护送至静安寺捕房，在那里向我展示了三叠钞票，其中一叠包含一枚三分公交车代币。在这笔3.20元的款项中，我挑出了一张红蓝相间的一元纸币，与被武装劫匪偷走的纸币相似。那枚三分公交车代币也看起来是我的。

在捕房期间，我还看到一名中国男子，我认出他是两名未持械劫匪中的一人。

（签名）Yee Bei Yeong.

House No. 65 West End Gardens, Yu Yuen
Road, is used partly as a liaison office of the
"Peace and National Construction Army", which
is sponsored by the WANG CHING WEI clique.
This office came into existence about the end
of 1939, and is in charge of one VAN MING
(范敏), alias VAN LI LONG (范利郎), a
battalion commander of the army in question.
He serves concurrently as a section chief of the
Special Service Group attached to the Shanghai
Office of the Ministry of Police, 76 Jessfield
Road.

The liaison office of the "Peace and
National Construction Army" has some ten members,
several of whom are in uniform and employed as
guards who are armed with Mauser pistols. The
number of guards increases when senior officers
of the army arrive in Shanghai, with their
henchmen from inland places.

Also living in House 65 West End Gardens
is another person named TING HSU VENG (丁旭文),
a native of Poetung, aged about 40. He is connected
with the WANG CHING WEI's headquarters at Lane 1136,
No. 31 Yu Yuen Road, and is responsible for enquiries
and the interrogation of political offenders opposed
to WANG's Regime. During the later part of May,
1940, TING applied to the Municipal Police for an

愚园路 West End Gardens 65号部分被用作汪精卫集团赞助的“和平建国军”的联络办事处。该办事处成立于1939年底，由范敏（VAN MING），别名范利郎（VAN LI LONG）负责，此人是上述军队的营长。他兼任极司菲尔路76号警察部上海办事处附属特别行动组的科长。

Subject 4th Route Army of the National Peace Salvation Army,
Nantao - Enquiries.

Made by D. I. Pan Lien-pih. Forwarded by D. I. Crawford.

With reference to the attached letter
dated May 26, 1940, from the Commander's Headquarters
of the 4th Route Army of the National Peace Salvation
Army at Nos.1-2, Ih Tuh Lee, Boon Lai Road, Nantao,
enquiries made show that the houses in question are
used by the Commander of the Army, Chia Kang (贾坤),
as his private residence. He has been living
there since May of this year, and some 10 male Chinese
also live there. A name card bearing the following
inscription "Quarters for Members, No Admission" and
"Masamitsu Koyama, Advisor of the 4th Route Army of
the National Peace Salvation Army" respectively,
appear on the wall at the door of the premises.
No armed guards are employed on the premises.

Chia Kang was given this post by the
Japanese Authorities with his headquarters in the
Western District but when the New Central Government
was inaugurated they declined to recognize the
organization commanded by Chia Kang, therefore Chia
Kang was compelled to leave Western Shanghai. Being
on good terms with the Japanese Military authorities,
he was allowed to live at the present address while
awaiting another position.

Pan Lien-pih

关于附件中1940年5月26日来自南市蓬莱路伊德里1-2号国民和平救国军第四路军司令部的信函，经查询显示，上述房屋由该军司令贾坤（Chia Kang）用作私人住所。他自今年5月起一直居住在那里，另有约10名中国男子也住在那里。 premises 门口的墙上贴有名片，分别写着“队员宿舍，谢绝入内”和“国民和平救国军第四路军顾问小山正光（Masamitsu Koyama）”。 premises 未雇佣武装警卫。

Translation of Letter No. Han 4° from 4th Route Army of Peace Movement National Salvation Army, 2 I Te Li, Boon Lai Road, Nantao.

May 28, 1940.

Police Department,
Shanghai Municipal Council.

Sirs,

According to the China Press, one of its reporters was given an interview by the Council and this Army was reported to have established its headquarters in an outside road and engaged in unlawful activities thereby menacing the maintenance of peace and order. In this connection we wish to point out that this Army was organized about 8 months ago with an object to effect national salvation by peace movement, having offices in Nantao; no offices being conducted in outside roads. Besides, military discipline is strictly maintained and all of our men carry out orders and observe law. Fearing that traitorous people might use the name of this Army to cause a disturbance and that our position might be misunderstood we would draw your attention to such malicious statement with the hope that you will not get confused in the matter as it reflects upon this Army and the maintenance of peace and order is involved.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE 28 MAY 1940 13）

(Signed): Chia K'un
Commander-in-Chief.

DISPUTE ON EDINBURGH ROAD, O.O.L. AND FUNCTIONING
OF PRO HONG CHING WEI GROUP FROM No.10, LANE 95
EDINBURGH ROAD, S.C.G.P.R.

At 9.30 p.m. 24-4-40, a telephone message was
received from a male Chinese named Zung reporting that
a number of male Chinese were hammering on the front of
his Rice Shop, No. 621 Edinburgh Road, O.O.L. and that
he was afraid.

Enquiries were conducted upon receipt of this call
but nothing definite could be ascertained.

Further enquiries on the a.m. of 25-4-40 by D.S.I.
Burton, D.S.I.Yao Yuen Loong and C.D.C.330 ascertained
the following:-

No.621 Edinburgh Road is the Tung Hai (東海) Rice
Shop owned and operated by one Wei Kyien Woo (虎金華).
At about 8.30 p.m. 24-4-40 Wei after closing his shop,
went to visit his neighbour Yeo Chien Liang (姚濟良)
owner of the Tung Tsang (同昌) Earthenware Shop, No.619
Edinburgh Road, whilst they were conversing together a
friend of Yeo's named Hoe (高), a broker employed at the
Yah Shing (正兴) Iron Foundry situated in the Tse Yue
Fang, S.C.G.P.R. also entered the shop and opened a
conversation with Yeo, whilst the conversation was in
progress Wei left the shop and returned to his own shop.

1940年4月24日晚9时30分，接到一名名叫 Zung 的中国男子的电话消息，报告称有一群中国男子正在敲打他位于爱丁堡路621号（外侨居留地界限以外）的米店前门，他感到害怕。

接到此电话后进行了查询，但未能确定任何确切情况。

1940年4月25日上午，由副督察 Burton、副督察姚济良（Yao Yuen Loong，音译）和 C.D.C.330 进行的进一步查询确定了以下情况：

爱丁堡路621号是东海（Tung Hai）米店，由虎金華（Wei Kyien Woo，音译）拥有并经营。1940年4月24日晚8时30分左右，魏某在关店后去拜访他的邻居姚濟良（Yeo Chien Liang，音译），姚是位于爱丁堡路619号的同昌（Tung Tsang）陶器店的店主。当他们交谈时，姚某的一位朋友高某（Hoe，音译）也进入店内并与姚某开始交谈，高某是受雇于位于苏格兰公共租界谢月坊（Tse Yue Fang，音译）正兴（Yah Shing）铁厂的一名经纪人。在谈话进行时，魏某离开店铺返回自己的店中。

Kao objected to this joke and an argument ensued resulting
in Wei and Kao coming to blows, they were parted by Yeo
and others before either had hurt each other and both
left Yoo's shop, Wei returning to his shop.
At about 9.30 p.m. 24-4-40, shortly after Wei had
returned to his shop repeated hammering was heard on his
shop front and on looking through the peep hole saw about
20 men armed with iron bars outside the shop, he became
afraid thinking the men were going to loot the shop and
rang the station as aforementioned.
Shortly after he had telephoned this station he
again looked through the peep hole and saw a number of
male Chinese whom he knows are from No.10, Lane 95 Edinburgh
Road and members of The National Salvation Army, requesting
the men outside his shop to disperse however this request
was refused and melee ensued, resulting in the 10 of the
men armed with iron bars being arrested by the above Army
Group, whilst the others dispersed, during the melee, 2
members of the Army Group received injuries to the head,
the 10 arrested men were taken away by the Army Group and
shortly afterwards, he was called by one of the members to
attend No.10 Lane 95 Edinburgh Road which he did and
after being interrogated for about 30 minutes as to the
cause of the trouble was allowed to go, during the
interrogation he was informed that the men who attacked with

高某对此玩笑表示反对，随即发生争执，导致魏某与高某大打出手。在双方均未受伤之前，叶某等人将他们拉开，两人随后离开了尤某的店铺，魏某返回了自己的店铺。
1940年4月24日晚上约9点30分，魏某回到店铺后不久，听到有人反复敲击他的店门。他透过窥视孔向外看，看到店外约有20名手持铁棍的男子。他心生恐惧，认为这些人意图抢劫店铺，遂如前所述打电话报警至本巡捕房。
他在给本巡捕房打完电话后不久，再次透过窥视孔观察，看到数名中国男子，他认识这些人来自爱丁堡路（Edinburgh Road）95弄10号，且是“救国军”的成员。他请求店外的男子散去，但这一请求被拒绝，随即发生混战。结果，10名手持铁棍的男子被上述军队团体逮捕，其余人则四散逃离。在混战中，该军队团体的2名成员头部受伤。这10名被捕男子被该军队团体带走。不久后，他被该团体的一名成员叫到爱丁堡路95弄10号，他照办了。在就事端起因接受约30分钟的讯问后，他被允许离开。在讯问期间，他获悉那些持铁棍袭击的人

Enquiries by C.D.C.73 and the undersigned ascertained the following:

At about 2.15 p.m. on 23-4-40 the accused described on page No.1 entered the ground floor of the Wing On Company department Store Nanking Road and looking at the goods displayed on the counters did not attempt to make any purchase. Shop-assistant No.564 named Chi Shing Yuen (仇新元) saw when the accused stole two lady's woollen jackets valued $30.00 from the counter and hiding the stolen property under his long gown walked towards the door. The shop assistant Chi Shing Yuen followed the accused and arrested him in possession of the stolen property. Private detective named Wong Soon (王松) employed at the Wing On Company was called and accompanied by shop assistant brought the accused to this station.

Questioned by detectives accused admitted the offence as outlined above. He admits having 3 previous convictions and stated that he was last released from Gaol about 8 months ago. Accused is now employed as Secretary of No.1 Section No.1 Route Army Shanghai Police Headquarters, Peace Salvation Army Headquarters in Pootung to which effect he possesses Certificate No.217. He also possesses a badge No.19 the translation of which reads:- Offices of Bureau for Officers of "Su" "Yung" and "Chen" districts, Termination Committee of Kiangsu, Chekiang and Anhwei Intelligence, Central Committee of the Intelligence in China.

经刑事侦缉处C.D.C.73及签署人查询，查明如下：

1940年4月23日下午约2点15分，第1页所述的被告进入南京路永安公司百货商店一楼，观看柜台上陈列的商品，但未尝试购买任何物品。564号店员仇新元（Chi Shing Yuen）看到被告从柜台窃取两件女式羊毛夹克（价值$30.00），并将赃物藏在长衫下走向门口。店员仇新元跟随被告，并在其持有赃物时将其逮捕。随后叫来受雇于永安公司的私家侦探王松（Wong Soon），由店员陪同将被告带至本巡捕房。

经警探讯问，被告承认上述罪行。他承认有3次前科，并称大约8个月前刚从监狱释放。被告现受雇为上海警察总局第一路军第一科秘书，持有浦东和平救国军总部颁发的第217号证书。他还持有第19号徽章，其译文为：“苏永陈地区军官局办事处，江浙皖情报终止委员会，中国情报中央委员会”。

In September, 1939, Wang Ching Wei, the ex-Deputy Executive of the Kuomintang of China, to reinforce his peace movement, proceeded to form a "China Peace National Salvation Alliance Army" (中華救國和平同盟軍) known in brief as "Peace National Salvation Army" (和平救國軍) which was to include in its ranks ex-soldiers, policemen and guerillas who had been induced to support Wang's cause. Wu Dah Si (吳大西), alias Wu Chang Ching (吳長清), was appointed commander of the proposed unit and subsequently established an office at the former site of the Chapei Benevolent Society off Dah Tung Road (大通路), Chapei.

The army took form towards the end of September, 1939 after several hundred men from various walks of life had been recruited under its banner. Some 300 of them under the command of Hu Teh Zang (胡德章), alias Hu Zang Ying (胡藏英), were despatched to the enclaves in the Western District at the beginning of October, 1939 when they established an office at No.18 Brenan Road, O.O.L. However, at the end of the same month they were transferred to Chapei and Lunghwa on account of their carrying out illegal activities in the area and thereafter the army has maintained only recruiting offices in the Western District. 该军队在1939年9月底初具规模，当时已有数百名来自社会各界的人士在其麾下应征入伍。其中约300人在胡德章（Hu Teh Zang），又名胡藏英（Hu Zang Ying）的指挥下，于1940年10月初被派往西区飞地，并在越界筑路区布伦安路18号设立办事处。然而，同月底，由于在该地区从事非法活动，他们被调往闸北和龙华，此后该军在西区仅保留招募办事处。后来组织了大约五个招募办事处，但只有

然而，这些办事处于1940年1月9日夜遭到日本宪兵队突袭。日本当局缴获了所有武器弹药，共计步枪550支、手枪约40支，并逮捕了100多人。据报，隶属于这些办事处的人员成分不良且纪律涣散，招致日本宪兵队和汪精卫派系的不满。

尽管遭到突袭，这支中华救国和平同盟军仍在汪精卫派系的庇护下进行组建，但迄今为止进展甚微/改革——

January 11, 1940.
Afternoon Translation.

Ta Mei Pao, Shun Pao, Ta Mei Wan Pao :-

"PEACE NATIONAL SALVATION ARMY" DISBANDED BY
JAPANESE IN NANTAO

According to information from reliable sources,
the so-called "Peace National Salvation Army" in Nantao was
entirely disbanded by the Japanese military authorities
yesterday afternoon.

At noon yesterday, 40 Japanese soldiers armed
with light machine guns first raided the barracks of a
detachment of the "Peace National Salvation Army" at Pai
Yun Kuan Temple (白雲觀). Several of the soldiers were
arrested and all documents and ammunition were removed.
A portrait of the late Dr. Sun Yat-sien and a Koumintang
flag were also taken away. A large number of the soldiers
who had received advance information of the intending raid
made good their escape.

At about 1 p.m. yesterday, the Japanese soldiers
raided the barracks of a detachment of the "Peace National
Salvation Army" in Kuan Ti Miao Temple (關帝廟) near West
Gate and placed all the soldiers under arrest.

The barracks of the second detachment of the
"Peace National Salvation Army" at the Chingkiang Guild
near West Gate were also raided. No arrests were made for all
the soldiers had already decamped after discarding their
badges and armlets. The Japanese then stopped all traffic
nearby and commenced to examine the passes of all pedestrians
with the result that 10 puppet soldiers were captured.

The reason for the disbandment of the "Peace
National Salvation Army" in Nantao is unknown.

《大美报》、《申报》、《大美晚报》：

“和平救国军”在南市被日军解散

据可靠消息来源称，南市的所谓“和平救国军”于昨日下午被日本军方当局完全解散。

昨日中午，40名携带轻机枪的日本士兵首先突袭了位于白云观的“和平救国军”某分队营房。数名士兵被捕，所有文件和弹药被带走。孙中山博士遗像和一面国民党党旗也被拿走。许多事先得到突袭消息的士兵成功逃脱。

昨日下午1时许，日本士兵突袭了位于西门附近关帝庙的“和平救国军”某分队营房，并将所有士兵逮捕。

位于西门附近京江公会的“和平救国军”第二分队营房也遭到突袭。由于所有士兵在丢弃徽章和臂章后已经逃散，未进行逮捕。随后日本人封锁了附近的所有交通，并开始检查所有行人的通行证，结果抓获了10名伪军士兵。

南市“和平救国军”被解散的原因尚不清楚。

逮捕“和平救国军”列兵及囚犯

1940年1月10日下午1时50分，华捕984号将一名身穿军装的中国男子和一名便衣男子带至警局，并报告称前者在爱多亚路（Avenue Haig）追逐后者时将其逮捕。
经副督察杨（D.S.I. Young）和华探长246号（C.D.C. 246）在警局讯问，穿军装的男子自称何凤鸣（Woo Voong Ming），系“和平救国军”列兵，驻极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road）29号。（这是中国国民党反共救国军特别服务团的一个分支。）
他接着说，不久前他的指挥官夏魁高（Hsia Kwei Kong）给了陈南（Zung Nan，原文如此，括号内中文为译者注：通常对应Chen Nan，但此处依原文拼音及常见译名可能指特定人物，暂按音译或保留原文拼音对应的汉字，此处根据上下文及常见人名推测为陈南，但若严格对应拼音Zung可能是宗或曾，鉴于后文有Sung Nan，此处存疑，依指令不确定保留原文加括号，但前文已有中文名，故沿用何凤鸣之例，若无法确定则保留。注：原文Zung Nan与后文Sung Nan似为同一人，此处依指令“能确定的用当时通行中文”，Zung/Sung音近，结合后文“陈南”的标注可能是OCR错误或拼写变异，但指令要求不脑补。然而原文在何凤鸣后直接给了中文名，而在Zung Nan后未给，但在叙述中又出现Sung Nan。细看原文：“gave $500.00 to one Zung Nan (陳南)”，原文已给出中文名陈南。故译为陈南。）500元；陈南承诺作为回报，前往苏州取回他藏在那里的五支毛瑟手枪，并交给夏魁高。
陈南未能返回，因此，被认为与陈南是朋友、曾在南京路浦记（Poo Chai）客栈同住一室的被羁押者王金木（Wong Ching Mau），于1940年1月18日晚8时在极司菲尔路靠近康纳路（Connaught Road）处被两名“和平救国军”列兵逮捕，并被带至极司菲尔路29号。

Suspected activities in the Settlement of
agents of the "National Peace Salvation Army".
----------------------------------------------

Sir,
There is every indication that agents of the
"National Peace Salvation Army"(和平救國軍)
movement are surreptitiously operating in the
Settlement (South of Creek), or are probably
endeavouring to establish branch offices, particularly
in hotels and lodging houses, for the supposed purpose
of enrolling members or circulating propaganda.

Several Kempo men claiming to be members of the
above organization were found closeted together in
Room 58, Wei Tsoong Hotel(惠中), 136 Shantung Road,
at about 6p.m. January 8.

They did not appear at the time to be engaged in
any subversive activities although examination of an
attache case found in the room revealed note-paper,
envelopes and chops definitely connecting them with
the "National Peace Salvation Army".

The occupants of the room were closely questioned
and all emphatically denied that they were assembled
there for any political reasons.

It was also ascertained that other members of
the Group are occupying Room 340, Wei Tsoong Hotel(惠中)

先生，
种种迹象表明，“和平救国军”（National Peace Salvation Army）运动的特工正在租界（苏州河以南）秘密活动，或者可能正试图设立分支机构，特别是在旅馆和客栈中，其所谓目的是招募成员或散发宣传品。

1月8日下午6时许，几名自称是上述组织成员的宪兵队人员（Kempo men）被发现关在山东路136号惠中饭店（Wei Tsoong Hotel）58号房间内密谈。

当时他们似乎并未从事任何颠覆活动，尽管对在该房间发现的一个公文包的检查显示，其中的信纸、信封和印章明确将他们与“和平救国军”联系在一起。

房间内的人员受到严密讯问，所有人都 emphatically 否认他们是为了任何政治原因聚集在那里。

制作人 副督察廖仲坚 转发人 C. Crawford J.

由汪精卫组建的中国和平救国同盟军，已在越界筑路区布伦南路路西宅93号设立了两个办事处。它们是：-
1. 中国和平救国同盟军第四路司令部 (中國和平救國軍第四路司令部)。
2. 中国和平救国同盟军第四路第二支队办事处 (中國和平救國軍第四路第二支隊)。

第一个办事处由吴独山（Woo Tuh San，注：前文为胡德山，此处拼音相同但汉字不同，依原文汉字翻译，或为同一人不同译名，前文括号内为胡德山，此处为吴独山，依指令保留原文汉字差异）负责，他是现已解散的“曹家渡反共自卫团”的前指挥官；而后者由徐履中（Zi Li Tsoong）控制，他是极司菲尔地区的无业游民，也是越界筑路区布伦南段泗阳茶楼（Sze Yang Tea Shop）的老板。

据说，这两个办事处的主要目的是为军队招募成员，但调查显示，这两个办事处均未开展此项工作。

Advertisement

The following notice inserted by Tsu Tsung-chu
(朱春駒) appears in the advertisement columns of the
"Sin Wan Pao" to-day:-
For the past two years I have never neglected
my duty as a citizen of the Republic of China and have
always struggled hard despite the difficulties in accordance
with the nation's policy. Although I was expelled from
Shanghai in August this year, my determination has never
wavered.
Lately I have learned that certain persons in
Shanghai have made unauthorized use of my name in the
formation of organizations. As my duty is confined only
to wharf affairs, I dare not go beyond my work and I
disclaim any part in other activities. Furthermore, the
financial matters of the labour union under my charge are

apart from appealing to the National Government for relief,

朱春驹今日在《新闻报》广告栏刊登如下声明：-
过去两年间，我从未懈怠作为中华民国公民的职责，并始终依照国家政策，不畏艰难而努力奋斗。尽管我于今年八月被逐出上海，但我的决心从未动摇。

The following advertisement, inserted by

It is detestable that outlaws, making use
of our name, are engaged in corrupt practices. Besides
instituting a strict investigation, we publish this
advertisement in the hope of getting genuine reports on
anything of this nature from the public. As regards our

various places in accordance with the peace policy, never

absolutely unnecessary for us to raise funds from the
public in support of this army as we have an ample reserve
fund.

The China Peace National Salvation Army
(中國和平救國同盟軍), which is being organized by Wang
Ching Wei, the ousted Deputy Chief of the Kuomintang,
has established a "Recruiting Office" (招募處) in

Service Corps of the Chung Kuo Kuomintang Anti-
Comintern and National Salvation Army, with one Wang
Tseng Ching (王正清) in charge. Wang, it is stated,
is a follower of Zi Li Chung (徐履中), a loafer
and the proprietor of the San Ming Bath House (三民浴室),
corner of Brenan and Jessfield Roads, O.O.L.

Ex-guerilla members, soldiers and policemen
may enrol with the recruiting office on recommendation
by persons having connection with the pro-Wang Ching
Wei clique. After joining, members will be issued
a monthly pay of $24.00 each and will be despatched
to join the various units of the army distributed in
the suburbs of Shanghai.

It will be recalled that some 300 men of this
Army entered the enclaves at the beginning of October,
1939 and were billeted at 18 Brenan Road, O.O.L..
They, however, were transferred to Chapei and Lunghwa
towards the end of the same month.

由中国国民党前副总裁汪精卫正在组建的中国和平救国军（中國和平救國同盟軍），已在极司菲尔路76号设立了一处“招募处”（招募處），该地亦为中国国民党反共救国军特别服务团总部，由一名叫王正清的人负责。据悉，王是徐履中的追随者，徐是个无业游民，也是位于白利南路与极司菲尔路转角处的三民浴室的老板，属越界筑路区。

前游击队员、士兵和警察，经与汪精卫派系有关系的人士推荐，可向该招募处报名。加入后，成员每人每月发放薪金24.00美元，并将被派往分布在上海郊区的各部队服役。

Ta Mei Wan Pao dated November 17 :- 18.11.29 (AM)

PEACE ARMY RECRUITING LOAFERS IN WESTERN DISTRICT

The so-called "Peace Army" is again contemplating certain activities in the "badlands" in the Western District. It will be remembered that the members of this army consist mostly of the armed followers of the mixed brigade of the Wang Ching-wei clique. In the hope of supporting their master in the assumption of his office, they are now making preparations for the expansion of their organization.

Besides establishing a branch in a village behind the Mint in Chapei, they have set up many "Recruiting Depots" in the "badlands." However, due to the poor response on the part of the residents nearby, but very few persons have been enlisted. Consequently, they have detailed representatives to Zau Ka Tu to continue enrolling loafers and in addition large numbers of running dogs have been sent to the suburban districts around Shanghai to induce ignorant and poor peasants to join the puppet army. It is said that as soon as an adequate number has been enlisted, training will begin.

《大美晚报》11月17日刊：- 1939年11月18日（上午）

和平军在西区招募无业游民

所谓的“和平军”再次计划在西区“歹土”地带进行某些活动。众所周知，该军成员主要由汪精卫派系混合旅的武装追随者组成。为了支持其主子上台就职，他们目前正在准备扩大其组织。

除了在闸北造币厂后面的一个村庄设立分部外，他们还在“歹土”地带设立了多个“招募站”。然而，由于附近居民响应寥寥，应征者极少。因此，他们派遣代表前往曹家渡继续招募无业游民，此外还派出大量走狗前往上海周边郊区，诱骗无知贫苦的农民加入伪军。据说，一旦征募到足够人数，训练即将开始。

November 1, 1939.
Morning Translation.

Chinese-American Daily News, Sin Wan Pao, Ta Mei Pao :-

"PEACE ALLIED ARMY" IN WESTERN DISTRICT TRANSFERRED
TO HANGCHOW AND CHANGCHOW

In the middle of September this year, a
"Peace Allied Army" was formed in the extra-Settlement
roads area in the Western District of Shanghai and
established headquarters on Brenan Road, Edinburgh Road
and vicinity. The army then posted handbills at Zau
Ka Tu supporting a certain person. Afterwards, members
of the army recruited men including more than 1,000
unemployed undesirables. A section of the men carry
Mauser pistols or big swords on duty outside their
headquarters, while others are unarmed and are not allowed
to go out.

During the past few days, guerrillas have
been very active along the Shanghai-Nanking and the
Shanghai-Hangchow Railways and severe fighting has taken
place at Hangchow and Changchow with the Japanese soldiers.
Due to the weakness of the Japanese at these places,
puppet soldiers have been transferred to engage the
guerrillas.

A few days ago, the unit of the "Peace
Allied Army" in the Western District under Zang Ying (常英)
received an order to move to Hangchow to engage the
guerrillas. Yesterday, the unit of the army under
Kao Feng-kwei (高鳳桂) received an order transferring
his men to Changchow.

The men of the "Peace Allied Army" dared
not oppose the order. They put on the military uniforms
issued by the Japanese to disguise them as Japanese
soldiers and were sent to Changchow.

《中美日报》、《新闻报》、《大美报》：

“和平联军”西区部队调往杭州和常州

今年九月中旬，一支“和平联军”在上海西区越界筑路地区组建，并在白利南路（Brenan Road）、爱丁堡路（Edinburgh Road）及附近设立总部。该军随后在曹家渡张贴传单，支持某个人物。此后，该军成员招募人员，包括一千多名无业游民。部分人员在总部外执勤时携带毛瑟手枪或大刀，其他人则未武装，且不被允许外出。

在过去几天里，游击队在京沪铁路和沪杭铁路沿线非常活跃，在杭州和常州与日军发生了激烈战斗。由于日军在这些地方兵力薄弱，伪军已被调去对付游击队。

前几天，常英（Zang Ying）率领的西区“和平联军”部队接到命令，调往杭州对付游击队。昨天，高凤桂（Kao Feng-kwei）率领的该军部队接到命令，将其部下调往常州。

“和平联军”的士兵不敢违抗命令。他们穿上日军发放的军服，伪装成日本士兵，被派往常州。

at 5.30 p.m., October 18, a search party
from the French Police arrested one Lu Pah Liang
(呂柏良) and eleven others in room 42, Tsung
Kiang No. 2 Lodging House, (春江第二旅館),

including a letter of appointment purporting to

LEADER OF TAIHU PIRATES ARRESTED BY THE FRENCH POLICE.
At 5 p.m. October 18, the French Police raided
the Chung King Hotel (春江旅館) at Tsai Ze Kai (菜市街)
off Rue du Consulat, French Concession, and arrested a man
named Lu Pai-liang (呂柏良), native of Taihu, age 49,
together with 12 other persons who were in Lu's room. Badges
and copies of letters of appointment issued by a so-called
"Allied Peace Salvation Army" of the "Reformed Government"
were seized.
Lu is believed to be a ringleader of the Taihu
pirates. On the advice of a fellow provincial named
Chirng Sz-ping (蔣思平), a Secretary of the "Allied Peace
Salvation Army," Lu came to Shanghai to make arrangements
with the leaders of the army for the surrender of his men
at Taihu.

Special report
forwarded.

The Western Branch Office of the "China Peace

by one Hu Teh Zang (胡經常), alias Hu Zang Ying

address, No.66 North Zao Ka Zah, off Brenan Road, has

receive a monthly pay of $30.00 each.

plain clothes, now wear green uniforms and hats each of
which bears a Kuomintang emblem, i.e. a white star on a
blue background.

汪精卫最近任命吴大西（Wu Da Si，别名吴长清 Wu Chang Ching）为一支即将组建的所谓“中华和平救国同盟军”的司令。吴是浙江绍兴人，50多岁，是闸北的房地产商。
吴已在闸北大统路（Tatung Road）旁的原闸北慈善团旧址设立了办事处。1939年9月20日，他任命过炳辉（Koo Ping Hwai）为上述军队第一师师长。过是江西人，约46岁，曾是孙传芳元帅（已故）麾下的军官。委任状上印有青天白日徽，‘日’上方有一面小型五色旗。这很可能是汪精卫即将 inaugurated 的新中央政府的徽记。
这位师长过炳辉已于1939年9月25日在闸北宋公园路（Soong Kung Yuen Road）旁的原儿童教养院旧址的办公室开始办公，目前正努力招募200人作为军队总部的警卫，并试图说服宋德胜（Soong Teh Sheng），这位在松江（Sungkiang）附近拥有约700人的游击队领导人

Ta Ying Yeh Pao of October 1 :- 2.10.39 (7/7)

NATIONAL SALVATION ARMY LEADER ABDUCTED

Ting Sih-san (丁錫山), who is one of the
leaders of mobile units operating in Pootung and district
south of the Whangpoo River, is now the Commander of the
8th Detachment of the Loyal and Righteous National
Salvation Army.
Recently it was reported that Ting Sih-san,
while on his way to Shanghai in disguise to attend to
certain important affairs, was abducted and taken to
Hongkew and compelled to surrender by followers of Wang
Ching-wei who had succeeded in bribing Ting's men. It is
said that he is still being held in detention because he
refuses to compromise.

救国军领导人被绑架

丁锡山（Ting Sih-san）是活动在浦东及黄浦江以南地区的机动部队领导人之一，现任忠义救国军第八支队司令。
近日有报道称，丁锡山在乔装前往上海处理重要事务途中，被汪精卫追随者绑架并带至虹口，强迫其投诚，这些追随者已成功贿赂丁的部下。据说，因他拒绝妥协，目前仍被拘留。

Sirs,

ABDUCTION OF A MALE CHINESE, O.O.L.

On 11-12-39, information was received by detectives
to the effect that the abducted man had been released and
was staying somewhere in the French Concession.
    All efforts of detectives to get in touch with any
members of the complainant's family have met with no
success and a message was left requesting the complt.
to communicate with this station.
    At 9 a.m. 12-12-39, the complainant came to this
station and corroborated the fact that her husband had
been released on 8-12-39 and at present was staying in
his brother's home at No.557 Rue de Seiyas, F.C.
    The undersigned accompanied by C.D.S.142 proceeded
to the above address and interviewed Mr. Wong Kya Zai
(王家瑞) who was confined to bed.
    He stated that having been taken from the house
by his abductors, he was placed in a M/car and was
driven West along Yu Yuen Road. On arrival at the
Brenan Road crossing the car stopped, one of the
abductors alighted and spoke to a Japanese Sentry, at
which permission was given to proceed. The car was
driven West along Brenan Road, turned North into
Chungshan Road, passed the Soochow Creek Bridge and
entered Ping Ming Tsung (平民) lane, where the
complainant was pulled out of the car and taken into
small house.
