1939年12月11日，侦探收到情报，称被绑架者已获释，正居住在法租界某处。
侦探为联系投诉人家属所做的一切努力均未成功，遂留下口信，请投诉人与本巡捕房联系。
1939年12月12日上午9时，投诉人来到本巡捕房，证实了其丈夫已于1939年12月8日获释，目前住在其兄弟位于法租界西爱咸斯路（Rue de Seiyas）557号的家中。
签署人偕同华探142号前往上述地址，会见了卧病在床的王家瑞（Wong Kya Zai）先生。
他陈述称，被绑架者从家中带走后，被置于一辆摩托车（M/car，此处可能指汽车或机动三轮车，依上下文及后文M/car Lic.No推测为汽车）中，沿愚园路向西行驶。到达布伦南路（Brenan Road）交叉口时，车辆停下，其中一名绑架者下车与一名日本哨兵交谈，随后获得放行许可。车辆沿布伦南路向西行驶，向北转入中山路，经过苏州河桥，进入平民村（Ping Ming Tsung）弄堂，投诉人被拉出车外，带进一所小房子。

XXXXXXX

My name is □ □□ □ong, am 25 years of age, and am
married, native of Kampo.

At about 9.00a.m. on July 6th., 1940 I was sitting
on the foot board of my unlicenced public ricksha which was
parked on Jessfield Road near Robison Road, when a male
Chinese approached from east and sat in my ricksha and
instructed me to pull him towards the west. Following
his instructions I proceeded along Jessfield Road and when
near the rear gate of Jessfield Park, three male Chinese
stepped out from the side of the road. One of them who was
wearing white clothing and ordered me to stop and at the
same time produced a pistol which he held in a threatening
manner.

I immediately stopped my ricksha and placed the shafts
on the ground. The passenger then stood up on the foot-
board and the armed man searched him and removed some
banknotes from his outer pocket and then placed them in his
own pocket.

At this juncture three or four male Chinese approached
us from various directions and said "Vah lau deong" and
opened fire with the result that all three robbers fell to
the ground.

I was later escorted to B'Well Police Station where I
saw a male Chinese whom I recognised as one of the unarmed
robbers.

(Signed) Wen Seh Fung.

XXXXXXX

我叫 □ □□ □ong（原文不清），25岁，已婚，籍贯江湾（Kampo）。

1940年7月6日上午9时许，我正坐在我那辆无执照的公共人力车的踏板上，该车停在靠近罗宾森路的极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road）上，这时一名中国男子从东面走来，坐进我的人力车，指令我向西拉他。遵照他的指令，我沿极司菲尔路前行，当接近极司菲尔公园后门时，三名中国男子从路边走出。其中一人身穿白衣，命令我停车，同时掏出一把手枪，以威胁的姿态持枪指着。

我立即停住人力车，将车辕放在地上。乘客随即站在踏板上，持枪者搜了他的身，从其外衣口袋中取出一些钞票，然后放入自己的口袋。

就在此时，三四名中国男子从不同方向向我们靠近，喊道“Vah lau deong”（原文不清，疑似方言或黑话），并开火射击，结果三名劫匪全部倒地。

随后我被护送至贝威尔（B'Well，即老闸）巡捕房，在那里我看到一名中国男子，我认出他是那名未持械的劫匪之一。

（签名）温世峰（Wen Seh Fung，音译）。

page_data.en:
Misc.No. 699/39.
1/sheet 2.

Black Chinese styled overcoats also entered the lane.
He was pulled by the men towards the house No.7 and
entered via the front door, which was open as the servants
were cleaning the house. On entering the ground floor
front room the first two men produced pistols and one of
the other two men who followed them pulled out a Mauser
and intimidated the watchman, and the man in uniform cap
searched him. On ascertaining that the watchman was not
armed, the men told him to keep quiet and the man wearing
uniform cap stood guard overhim, whilst the other three
men, proceeded upstairs. On the stairway they encountered
an amah Sung Wah Sa (沈惠兒) and ordered her to switch
on the lights, and then entered the complainant's (front
first floor) room the door of which was not locked.
The man wearing dark brown overcoat, armed with a
pistol saw the complainant and her husband sleeping in
bed and awakened them by calling to them to get up. Then
he told them not to be afraid as they were guerrillas
looking for opium. Mr. Wong Epa Sai then saw another
man going upstairs and requested them not to frighten the
children / who were in a room on the 2nd floor. The man in dark
brown overcoat told the complainant not to worry and then
proceeded to open and examine drawers of the wardrobe and
chest of drawers. Some of the drawers were locked and
page_data.zh:
杂项编号 699/39。
1/第2页。

身穿黑色中式大衣的人也进入了弄堂。
他被那些人拉向7号房屋，并通过前门进入，当时仆人正在打扫房子，门是开着的。进入一楼前厅后，最先的两名男子掏出手枪，紧随其后的另外两人中的一人拔出一把毛瑟手枪恐吓看门人，戴制服帽的男子搜了他的身。在确定看门人没有武器后，那些人让他保持安静，戴制服帽的人负责看守他，而另外三人则上楼。在楼梯上，他们遇到了女佣沈惠兒（Sung Wah Sa），命令她打开电灯，然后进入了投诉人（位于二楼前部）的房间，该房间的门未上锁。
身穿深棕色大衣、手持手枪的男子看到投诉人和她的丈夫睡在床上，便叫他们起床，将他们唤醒。然后他告诉他们不要害怕，他们是寻找鸦片的游击队。王阿彩（Wong Epa Sai，音译）先生随后看到另一个人上楼，请求他们不要惊吓在二楼房间里的孩子们。穿深棕色大衣的男子告诉投诉人不要担心，然后开始打开并检查衣柜和五斗橱的抽屉。有些抽屉是锁着的，并且

page_data.en:
Misc.No. 699/39.
1/sheet 3.

the complainant was told to open them, which she did. On
finding nothing the man approached Mr. Wong Kya Zai, in
order, apparently, to search him and the latter produced
his wallet. The armed man took out the money, about
$70.00 and left the wallet on the table. On arrival of
the Police the room had already been cleaned, therefore
no finger prints could be found. At that time the man
armed with a revolver came down from the 2nd floor rooms
and brought two amahs and the two complainant's daughters,
after which the complainant and her husband were ordered
to come down to the ground floor, where all the members
of the household except Mr. Wong were forced into a bed-
room and locked therein. The complainant then saw that
their 3rd amah and a slave girl were already there.
Then the watchman was also brought there and locked
together with the inmates, after which the armed men left
taking Mr. Wong with them. A few minutes later some of
the neighbours came into the house to enquire what the
matter was and released the complainant and the other
inmates.
Further enquiries were made amongst the neighbours,
and several witnesses (names known to investigating
detectives) were located who had seen the armed men arrive
in a W/car No. 852 from the Westerly direction. The
page_data.zh:
杂项编号 699/39。
1/第3页。

投诉人被要求打开它们，她照做了。由于一无所获，该男子走近王家瑞（Wong Kya Zai）先生，显然是为了搜身，后者拿出了他的钱包。持枪男子取出约70元的钱，将钱包留在桌上。警察到达时，房间已被清理过，因此未能找到指纹。当时，手持左轮手枪的男子从二楼房间下来，带来了两名女佣和投诉人的两个女儿，随后投诉人及其丈夫被命令下楼至一楼，除王先生外的所有家庭成员都被迫进入一间卧室并被锁在里面。投诉人随后看到他们的第三名女佣和一名婢女已经在那里。
接着看门人也被带到这里，与屋内人员一起被锁住，之后持枪者带着王先生离开。几分钟后，一些邻居进入屋内询问发生了什么事，解救了投诉人和其他被困人员。
侦探在邻居中进行了进一步询问，并找到了几名目击者（姓名调查侦探已知），他们看到持枪者乘坐一辆车牌号为852的西式汽车（W/car）从西边方向抵达。该

page_data.en:
Misc.No. 699/39.
1/sheet 4.

M/car was turned about and parked near the entrance of
the lane, where it waited for the return of the armed men,
who placed Mr. Tong into the car and drove away west along
Yu Yuen Road.

It was learned from the Traffic Office that the M/car
Lic.No.5419 was registered in the name of Wu Sang Ying,
residing at No.ID4, Lane No.318 Tientsing Road. This
address was visited by D.S.I. Burton with assistance of
D.S. Shimoshima and C.D.C.222 of Hongkew Station and was
found to be a branch office of the Special Section of
the Japanese Army. Neither the car nor Wu Sang Ying
could be found, but a Japanese named K. Nakajima confirmed
that the M/car Lic.No.5419 belonged to their office and
was licensed in the name of Wu Sang Ying, who was employed
and resided at the above address. K. Nakajima further
added that he himself used the said M/car between 8.30a.m.
and 11.30a.m. 2-12-39, but denied having been in the
vicinity of Yu Yuen Road.

Mr. Yorke, D.O. "B" was informed and on his
instructions a message was circulated by teleprinter to
all stations, requesting to stop M/car Lic.No.5419.

Further interviewed by detectives, the complainant
said that the only party, who could wish any harm to her
husband was one Sze Hon Tsang (徐茂昌) who had a grudge
against her husband, because of a financial dispute whi-
page_data.zh:
杂项编号 699/39。
1/第4页。

摩托车（M/car，此处应指汽车，与前文W/car对应，可能档案记录混用）掉头停在弄堂入口附近，等待持枪者返回，他们将汤先生（Mr. Tong，此处疑为王先生之误，或另一受害者，结合上下文应为王先生）放入车内，沿愚园路向西驶离。

从交通科获悉，车牌号为5419的汽车登记在吴尚英（Wu Sang Ying，音译）名下，住址为天津路318弄ID4号（原文ID4，可能为104或类似编号，照实译出）。探长伯顿（Burton）在虹口巡捕房探员岛下间（Shimoshima，音译）和华探222号的协助下走访了该地址，发现这是日本陆军特务科的分支机构。既未找到该车，也未找到吴尚英，但一名叫中岛 K.（K. Nakajima）的日本人确认，车牌号5419的汽车属于他们的办公室，并以吴尚英的名义注册，吴受雇于此并居住在上述地址。中岛 K. 还补充说，他本人在1939年12月2日上午8:30至11:30之间使用了该辆汽车，但否认曾在愚园路附近出现。

已通知“B”分区警官约克（Yorke）先生，根据他的指示，通过电传打字机向所有巡捕房发布消息，要求拦截车牌号为5419的汽车。

经侦探进一步讯问，投诉人称，唯一可能希望加害其丈夫的人是徐茂昌（Sze Hon Tsang），此人与其丈夫有仇，起因是大约6年前恒發（Hung Lei）钱庄破产引发的财务纠纷，当

page_data.en:
Misc.No.699/39.

1/sheet 5.

resulted from the bankruptcy of the Hung Lei (恒發)
native bank about 6 years ago, when Zee's father, who
had managed the bank's affairs, lost his capital and Mr.
Wong's father, who was a partner of the bank, refused to
share the loss. This dispute was the subject of the
Court proceedings in July 1939 when Zee lost his
case. He was known to have told his friends that he
would find some way to bring pressure upon Mr. Wong in
order to make him settle the dispute in a way favourable
to Zee. According to the complainant her husband had no
other enemies and had no connection with any political
affairs.

The complainant was advised to inform the Police
immediately if she receives any communication either from
her husband or from his abductors.

Informed:-
D.C. (CRIME)
D.C. "B"
D.D.O. "E"

D.S.I.

1/第5页。

时徐的父亲作为钱庄经理损失了资本，而王的父亲作为钱庄合伙人拒绝分担损失。这场纠纷成为1939年7月法庭诉讼的主题，当时徐败诉。据悉他曾告诉朋友，他会想办法向王先生施压，迫使王先生以有利于徐的方式解决纠纷。据投诉人称，她丈夫没有其他敌人，也与任何政治事务无关。

已建议投诉人，如果收到来自其丈夫或绑架者的任何信件，应立即通知警方。

General enquiries.

The two accused in this case again appeared
before the S.S.D.Court on the 8-11-41 when, after
further trial, they were found guilty and sentenced
to six years' imprisonment each.

As stated in previous diaries there are three
persons still wanted for this offence. Their names
and descriptions are given in Diary 1. A Circular
Order No. 578 for their arrest is on file at Chongtu
Road Station.

Part of the stolen property is still not yet
recovered.

Appropriate action will be taken as soon as any
information is obtained regarding either the wanted
persons or the remainder of the stolen property.

一般查询。

本案两名被告于1941年11月8日再次出庭受审，经进一步审理后，被裁定罪名成立，各判处六年监禁。

正如先前日记所述，仍有三人因本案在逃。其姓名及体貌特征见日记1。关于逮捕此三人的第578号通缉令已存档于崇途路巡捕房。

部分被盗财物尚未追回。

一旦获得有关在逃人员或剩余被盗财物的任何情报，将立即采取适当行动。

the Judge and implicated the three men named in Diary 1.

During the time the two accused were in Court a
male Chinese approached the 2nd accused and began
talking to him. P.P.C. 363 observed this and informed
D.S.I. Elders who instructed that the man be brought
to the station for questioning.

（印：SPECIAL BRANCH）

When questioned at the station the man gave his
name as Woo Kung Foo (何根福) age 19, residing in an
unnumbered house in Passage 153 Rue Louis Dufour F.C.,
and employed as apprentice at 503 Range Road. He is
the 2nd accused's brother and had heard of the 2nd
accused being arrested and had gone to the Court to
see him. His place of employment was communicated with
and his statement verified. There being nothing against
him he was released.

（批：Diary & forwarded
7-10-41）

During the period of remand the two accused have
been further questioned but no evidence has been
obtained to connect them with any other offences and

法官，并牵连了日记1中列名的三名男子。

在两名被告出庭期间，一名中国男子走近第二被告并开始与其交谈。巡捕363号观察到这一情况，并报告了侦探警长Elders，后者指示将该男子带至巡捕房进行讯问。

（印章：特别处）

在巡捕房接受讯问时，该男子自称何根福（Woo Kung Foo），19岁，居住于法租界路易·杜福尔路（Rue Louis Dufour）153弄内无门牌号的房屋，受雇于兰格路（Range Road）503号做学徒。他是第二被告的兄弟，听说第二被告被捕，便前往法院探视。已与其雇主联系核实，其供词属实。因未发现其有任何嫌疑，故予以释放。

（批注：日记 & 转发
1941年10月7日）

在两被告还押候审期间，已对其进行了进一步讯问，但未获取任何证据将其与其他罪行联系起来，且

page_data.en:
4/Sheet No. 2.

they are unable to render any assistance to locate their
three accomplices. Detectives have been endeavouring
to pick up some information regarding the whereabouts
of those men but so far, with no useful result. Pawnshops,
goldsmith's shops and such likely places of disposal
are also being visited in search of the remainder of the
stolen property but so far, no trace of it has been
found. No information has been obtained from Colonel
Tao Sih Sung who promised to try and have the three
wanted men arrested and recover the remainder of the
stolen property.

An application for a Circular Order of Arrest
against the three wanted men is submitted herewith.

The case will again come before the Court on the
8/11/41.

D. S. I.

D. D. O. "A"

Officer i/c, Sp. Br.

他们无法提供协助以 locating 其三名同伙的下落。侦探们一直努力搜集有关这些人在何处的信息，但迄今未有成效。当铺、金店及其他可能的销赃场所也已被走访，以搜寻剩余的被盗财物，但迄今未发现其踪迹。从陶锡松（Tao Sih Sung）上校处未获得任何情报，他曾承诺设法逮捕这三名在逃人员并追回剩余的被盗财物。

现提交针对这三名在逃人员的通缉令申请。
